jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery - Remote
jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Project Manager for our Power Delivery Project Management team located in Rochester, NY; Syracuse, NY; New York City, NY; Boston, MA; Portland, ME; or Newark, NJ.

The candidate may work from a mutually acceptable location within the region and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings. The successful candidate will be responsible for initiating and executing Power Delivery projects, managing and developing client relationships, and marketing WSP’s Power Delivery services to existing and new clients in the respective region.

This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
May participate, and at times, lead the contract negotiations and client presentations
Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan.
Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
Provide guidance and mentoring to other staff.
Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market.
12 years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry
Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.
Minimum of 5 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects.
Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:
Contract Management
External and Internal Team Meeting Management
Earned Value Management
Change Management
Risk Management
Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
Financial Management

Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
Occasional travel is required and travel frequency will depend on client and project-specific requirements.

WSP Benefits

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.
Compensation:
Expected Salary (all locations): $180,000-$245,000
WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

Notice To Third Party Agencies

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.title: Program Manager of Value Execution - Remote
jobs.description:
For those who want to invent the future of health care, here's your opportunity. We're going beyond basic care to health programs integrated across the entire continuum of care. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Program Manager, Value Execution is responsible for supporting the execution, administration, and continuous improvement of clinical operations programs. This role partners across clinical, operational, and technology teams to coordinate projects, manage operational processes, support workforce readiness, and drive successful implementation of strategic initiatives while ensuring efficient and effective program delivery.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities

Supports the operational execution and ongoing management of clinical operations programs, including implementation, deployment, and process improvement initiatives
Coordinates project plans, governance activities, meeting facilitation, action item tracking, communications, and reporting to support program objectives
Leads operational readiness activities for new workflows, pilots, facility onboarding, and service expansions
Partners with clinical, operational, analytics, and technology teams to gather requirements, prioritize work, and drive successful project execution
Supports maintenance of operational workflows, process documentation, job aids, and supporting resources
Manages system access and onboarding processes, including coordination of EMR access, security requests, and workforce readiness activities
Identifies risks, develops mitigation plans, and escalates issues as appropriate
Supports reporting and performance-monitoring activities to inform operational decision-making
Builds and maintains effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Leads or participates in cross-functional projects and continuous improvement initiatives

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in healthcare operations, program management, project management, or clinical operations
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Experience creating process documentation, workflows, and project plans
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint
Proven solid organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting care management, care coordination, population health, or value-based care programs
Experience with operational reporting, workflow optimization, or process improvement initiatives
Experience supporting program implementations, pilots, or operational deployments
Knowledge of healthcare systems, hospital operations, or post-acute care workflows
All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline:
This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

OptumCare is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

OptumCare is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment

jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 106342

Project Manager Sr

Location:

This role is fully remote

Insight at a Glance

14,000+ engaged teammates globally
$8.2 billion in revenue in 2025
Certified as a Great Place to work in 9 Countries in 2025
Fortune 500 Company (No. 447) in 2025
Received 25+ industry and partner awards in the past year
$1.4M+ total charitable contributions in 2024 by Insight globally

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator
with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

About The Role

The Project Manager Sr (PM) is responsible for managing, directing and overseeing the delivery of assigned projects and programs. The PM provides visible leadership, accountability and authority over high profile projects and programs delivered to Insight clients. The PM works independently and exhibits a high degree of initiative in resolving problems encountered and developing recommended solutions. The PM must be flexible in delivering projects with different methodologies based on client and team needs. Job responsibilities include:

Manage project and program teams to deliver highly visibly strategic solutions for our clients using waterfall, hybrid, and agile methodologies.
Manage all aspects of the project lifecycle from initiation through close-out and transition.
Help define and drive strategic direction of both Insight and our clients.
Build key relationships with clients and leaders.
Mitigate risk and proactively work project issues.
Drive tangible and sustainable improvement in PM capabilities.
Assist with business development activities to grow Insight Services business.
Mentor less experienced Project Managers.

Be AmbITious:
This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

What You’ll Need To Join Insight

Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university
7 years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience in the IT services, IT Operations or professional services industry.
Experience with hybrid methodologies and agile delivery of technical projects.
PMP or Agile certification.
Track record of success guiding and leading project teams to success.
Skills in all aspects of project management lifecycle and critical processes:
Project Initiation
Planning and Work Breakdown
Resource Management
Budget Management
Stakeholder Management
Scope Management
Risk Management
Must be passionate about continuous improvement.
Must be able to manage technical resources working on multiple projects seamlessly.
Must be an excellent communicator - both written and oral.
Must have excellent customer relationship management skills.

The base salary range for this position is typically $110,000 to $130,000 with additional bonus and benefits available. However, compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case, including experience and location, and we will also consider candidates outside of this range as necessary.

What You Can Expect

We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family and to help you engage with your local community.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

Join us today, your ambITious journey starts here.

Insight is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by law.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

At Insight, we celebrate diversity of skills and experience so even if you don’t feel like your skills are a perfect match - we still want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Project Manager - Utility Scale Solar
jobs.description:
Project Manager, Utility Scale Solar

Location
– Remote US

Job Summary

The Project Manager is a newly created opportunity within a prominent fast-growing renewable energy developer, project owner, and IPP with over 3 GW of solar and battery projects. This full-time opportunity will join a nationally recognized leadership team and be responsible for working with multiple internal project teams to manage large scale, complex solar and battery storage projects to meet essential metrics for safety, quality, schedule, and financial performance. The PM is the primary point of contact for clients and other external stakeholders, while leading internal teams to execute the projects successfully. The Project Manager opportunity will offer a competitive compensation package comprised of a base salary in the $155,000 to $165,000 range, a 25% annual bonus target, excellent benefits, and strong career mobility potential within the company’s rapidly scaled growth track. This position will offer a fully remote work schedule however candidates must be able to travel domestically as needed.

Project Manager – Job Description

Plan, execute, monitor, control and close out and complete turn-key PV and battery storage projects and portfolios of high complexity and corresponding challenges
Serve as a key point of contact for clear, accurate and timely communications to management and key stakeholders
Create and manage budgets to provide effective financial control for the project activities; Support cost reduction efforts and actively participate in cost reviews
Develop and manage project schedules to track process of the work, identify and mitigate potential problems, accelerate velocity, and provide accurate reporting of actual and forecasted dates
Develop and implement comprehensive risk management strategies based on thorough understanding of the work and realistic means to mitigate exposure
Read contract agreements and develop a detailed understanding of the requirements; Ensure that the project team works to fulfill all contract requirements and minimize the potential for disputes and conflicts.
Coordinate design and permitting activities with the project development and execution team and local authorities
Develop a schedule and manage the activities for material procurement with the Procurement team; Develop schedule and manage activities for contracting, including developing scopes and contract documents.
Effectively oversee all construction activities and schedules with field operations and contractors to ensure alignment with production targets, phasing, staging and logistics; Ensure the safety and quality of the delivered projects in compliance with company standards.

Project Manager – Job Qualifications

5+ years construction and project management experience; demonstrated experience with utility scale solar EPC
BS in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred
Comprehensive understanding of electrical, structural, and civil construction processes and requirements
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Project or Primavera P6
Advanced ability for decision-making, accountability, planning, leadership, and communication in dynamic, stressful situations.
Thorough understanding of construction contracts and administration
Technical understanding of working with utilities and AHJ’s
Knowledge of construction safety requirements; OSHA 10 or 30 certification
Ability to travel as needed within the US to project sites.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is currently seeking a driven, results oriented and motivated self-starter with a project and program management background to join the NISC team as a Project Manager in support of the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) surveillance and radar modernization effort. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, organizing, securing and managing resources to bring about the successful completion of specific program goals and objectives. Duties may include ensuring that all projects run within scope, time, and budget constraints. This role also interfaces with task and functional leaders, subcontractors, and support personnel coordinating activities to bring new equipment online at FAA facilities. The candidate will work independently on larger, moderately complex projects/assignments and may assist other professionals with tasks and assignments.

Key Responsibilities

Day to day responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Ensure all projects schedules are met and within budget constraints.
Provide timely/accurate responses to all technical and program inquiries received.
As required, assist in budget formulation activities utilizing FAA government databases.
As applicable, author required documents in support of program schedules.
Work independently to achieve day-to-day Program objectives which may significantly impact operational results or program objectives.
Update project schedules as required and provide input to FAA construction managers.
Organize impromptu telecons/meetings to ensure all project maintain schedule and cost.
Utilizing special client databases, provide programmatic input to other team members.
Perform investigations and root cause analysis.
Other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

Requires a BA or BS degree and 4 to 8 years of prior relevant experience OR additional years of relevant experience may be considered/accepted in lieu of a degree” .
Ability to work well with others
Ability to present ideas to diverse audiences
Proficient with MS Project and Excel (Macros)
Prior experience supporting the FAA

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of FAA radar technology
Technical background (Highly preferred)
Lean/Six Sigma Analysis skills
Data Analytics
Data architecture
Thrives in Ambiguity: Excels at creating structure, defining scope, and delivering results when initial parameters or guidelines are open-ended
Brings clarity to unstructured situations
Agile problem solver
Maintains composure and productivity during high-stakes situations.
Comfortable navigating shifting priorities and undefined project scopes.
Skilled at bringing structure and strategy to rapidly evolving environments.

Nemean Solutions, headquartered in Sierra Vista, AZ, is a certified SBA 8(a) Native Hawaiian Organization (NHO) and veteran-operated company providing advanced Military Intelligence, Enterprise and Cloud IT services, Cybersecurity, Special Operations Forces (SOF) Exercise and Training, and niche Program Support and Professional Services to Federal and State Agencies supporting the US Government Defense, Intelligence and Aerospace sectors.

Job Summary

The Program Manager supports National Weather Service (NWS) science and research priorities, particularly Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) and social science data integration, by documenting user needs, managing cross-office and cross-discipline projects, supporting communications and policy activities, advancing AI strategic planning, and coordinating key councils, committees, and working groups.

User Needs and Project Management

Document and manage user needs for NWS science and research, particularly for AI/ML and social science data integration projects.
Provide project management for cross-office and cross-discipline AI/ML projects, including drafting proposals and project plans; managing costs, schedule, and scope; supporting team execution; and identifying collaboration opportunities across NWS, NOAA, academia, and private partners.

Communications

Coordinate presentations, documentation, and talking points to communicate program status to NOAA and NWS management.

Review current and draft AI policy and legislation for impacts, write summaries, and provide recommendations on implementation.

Support the OSTI Chief Scientist in reviewing and preparing materials and coordinating with stakeholders for the NOAA Science Advisory Board (SAB) and the NOAA Science Council.

Expertise with Pharma advertising and industry
Experience managing AOR programs/Canadian Pharma regulations; PAAB
Excellent leadership, communication and negotiation skills
Highly organized, detail-oriented and motivated

Able to organize and prioritize, set and meet deadlines.

The PMO Regulatory Compliance team is part of the Strategy, Business Operations, Risk Management and Program Management department (SBOPC) within Booking.com's Accommodations Business Unit. Our stakeholder landscape spans Product, Tech, Legal, Tax, Partner Affairs, Partner facing teams, and Go-to-market, making this a role where your influence reaches far beyond a single team.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Project Manager, you own the end-to-end delivery of complex, business-critical programs. That means driving scoping, building the implementation strategy, and seeing initiatives through from problem definition to handover, on time and to standard.

What You Will Do

Lead medium-to-large programs with senior stakeholder involvement across multiple departments
Own governance: progress tracking, risk and dependency management, fast decision-making loops, and escalation where needed
Translate ambiguous business needs into clear plans, milestones, and accountability structures
Align program roadmaps to ABU and company priorities, and communicate progress and risks to senior leadership
Drive change management and communications where rollouts touch a broad group of stakeholders

In the short term, you will likely focus on one of our highest-visibility programs: supporting the implementation of a new company-wide One Payment Model. Over time, you will take on broader Compliance program management.

What You Bring

Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional programs in a fast-paced environment.
Strong stakeholder management, comfortable engaging up to Director-level, and navigating ambiguity without losing momentum
Excellent communication and facilitation skills; you write and present with clarity
Structured thinker who can zoom out to strategy and zoom in to execution detail
A strong ability to deal with uncertainty & change
You do not wait to be unblocked. you identify what is needed and make it happen

Practical
:

Based in the Netherlands | Hybrid working model

Craft Methodology and Standards:

Lead best practice behaviors within ABU (Accommodations Business Unit) and be an ambassador for Project Management methodology by contributing to company adoption Program Management standards across the company

E2E Project Management

Lead independently end-to-end (E2E) company / ABU priority programs from initiation to completion including go-to-market.

Project Initiation and Planning:

Drives the project scoping and planning working with different teams and creating associated documentation.
Brings clarity to sponsor, teams and stakeholders by defining and documenting program objectives, requirements and success criteria, KPIs, roadmap/E2E planning, risk and dependencies, cost estimates and in general program deliverables.

Drive Project plan execution, ensuring objectives are met on agreed timelines. Brings Projects to completion ensuring seamless Go-Live and smooth handover to operations
Track and report status and progress of all streams of work, identifying and highlighting where required, risk/issues/dependencies to governance groups or team members/groups. Create plans and actions to mitigate/solve risks, issues and/or dependencies.

Project Governance

Design and implement project governance and delivery structure to ensure efficient delivery, communication and decision making
Maintain project management frameworks & templates and follow up if needed with any improvement feedback.

Delivery/Impact

Drive the progress and successful delivery of initiatives that bring significant value to the business. They are the driving force that collaborates with multiple teams to ensure that teams deliver significant change to the business covering the full scope, on agreed timelines and budget (where applicable).

Stakeholder Management

Strong in stakeholder management and communication.
Ability to work and productively interact with different stakeholders up to Director Level.
Primary point of contact for the program related queries.
Maintain high-level of engagement among geographically-diverse stakeholders through social channels, email, facilitation & setup of virtual meetings & classroom settings, as well as individual in-person meetings.

Success Metrics

Define and measure the success metrics of the Project(s)/Workstreams in scope.

Facilitator

Lead independent workshops to support the delivery of the Project(s).

5+ years of relevant work experience
Strong Project Management Experience. Preferably having a background in Agile Project Management
PMP or Agile Project Management or equivalent certification is preferred.
With limited supervision, ability to use quantitative and qualitative data to drive decision making
Familiar with change management approaches; good understanding of the change curve and process
Communication of the project insights and recommendations across all stakeholders
Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships (both within a team and with wider stakeholders. Ability to work effectively and influence up to Senior Managers and Director Level
Highly organized and structured and make sure all processes run smoothly and in a reliable manner.
Be able to lead, motivate, and manage stakeholders and project teams to achieve organizational goals. They also should be able to influence and steer senior management and groups. Challenge assumptions and ability to adapt or generate imaginative and innovative ideas
Flexibility and the ability to function well within ambiguity and in a constantly changing environment.
Ability to solve complex problems with minimal supervision. They are able to break up a complex problem into actionable and easy to understand solutions. They are hands on and drive solutions to problems in partnership withs the involved parties.
Sr Project Managers make sure the project's outcomes are in line with customer needs and/or expectations
Have experience working with Product and Tech teams

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

COME JOIN OUR JOURNEY!

When you join TT, you join our global community of visionaries, creators, and achievers dedicated to engineering and manufacturing electronic solutions enabling a safer, healthier and more sustainable world. Simply put, we are a global manufacturer with a passion for engineering advanced electronics that benefit our planet and people for future generations. We are committed to having a positive impact on the world through a culture built around safety, transparency, collaboration, and positive relationships. Our teams are fueled by performance and expertise, leading the charge in innovation, efficiency and delivering world-class customer service. Be part of the journey.

Role Overview And Responsibilities

Introduction

The Program Manager serves as TT Electronics’ primary point of contact and interface with the customer, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and coordination across all aspects of the customer relationship. The Program Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the assigned customer accounts, including but not limited to, revenue performance, profitability, order excellence, and the overall customer experience . The Program Manager ensures cross-functional alignment across TT teams, drives effective program execution, and maintains a high level of customer satisfaction.

This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary customer focal point, providing comprehensive oversight of the Customer-TT Electronics relationship while supporting existing and new opportunities for business growth.

Direct and lead the Customer-Focused Team in day-to-day activities, driving timely and effective conflict resolution and proactively identifying and addressing opportunities for continuous improvement.
Serve as the “Voice of the Customer” within TT Electronics by maintaining a comprehensive understanding of customer programs, requirements, priorities, and risks, while ensuring these are effectively communicated across the organization and cross-functional teams.
Accountability for the accuracy, timely maintenance, and effective communication of schedules, order books, forecasts, and contract requirements.
Understand, or possess the ability learn, finance acumen including but not limited to, gross margin, operating profit, and pricing cost structures.
Accountable and responsible for the financial performance of assigned products and customer accounts, including, but not limited to, pricing, profitability, PPV, gross margin, material liabilities, on-time delivery, quality, and cost-savings opportunities
Accountable and responsible in maintaining working knowledge of contract (Supply Agreement) requirements while proactively managing financial risk and liability to TT Electronics.
Prepare and present regular business updates for internal Account Reviews, customer Business Reviews, and other forums as required.
Leverage a comprehensive understanding of customer needs and requirements to support Senior Leadership in the development of annual sales plans, budgets, and related business planning activities.
Travel to customer sites, as well as lead internal visits, in support of business reviews, relationship management, and program requirements.
Demonstrate active involvement in and support of TT Electronics’ health and safety, compliance, and quality management systems.
Support Account Managers in the overall success and growth of assigned accounts.

Core Requirements

Qualifications, Skills and Attributes

Education/Experience/Credentials: Bachelor’s Degree or two to four years’ combined experience and training/education. Experience managing highly regulated industries (Medical, Aerospace, Defense) and/or industry certifications is a plus.
Language Ability : Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to read and analyze periodicals, business reports, correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to write clear and professional reports, business correspondence, and procedural documentation. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, team members, and the public. The individual must demonstrate strong grammar, editing, and proofreading skills.
Math Ability: Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.
Reasoning Ability: Ability to collect and analyze data, solve practical problems, and work effectively with a variety of concrete variables in situations where limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret instructions presented in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Must consistently maintain a professional and positive image in all situations while exercising sound judgment.
Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office with emphasis on Excel & SharePoint. Familiar with ERP systems, Business Intelligence portals, etc. Basic Sales Force knowledge is a plus.
Supervisory Responsibilities: None.
Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The employee may be required to work from a home office and must ensure that the workspace is appropriately equipped to support a professional, distraction‑free environment. The individual must be able to self‑supervise and manage time effectively to meet company expectations. The noise level in the work environment is typically quiet
Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include the ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers for dexterity; handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; and communicate effectively. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stand; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
Travel Requirements: Sufficient travel will be required to support job functions, 10% to 20% of your time is the expectancy to support our business.
Training requirements : Team members will be required to attend various training classes to ensure adequate knowledge of company specific information, customer, regulatory, and other requirements as determined by job process, standard operating procedures or other elements as required.

This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), which means that limitations relating to nationality may apply.

Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Solving Technology Challenges for a Sustainable World

We want the very best people in our TT family across the globe – so we welcome applications from everyone, to celebrate a diverse mix of experiences, backgrounds and identities. We are committed to equality of opportunity for all and you can rest assured that TT Electronics takes positive steps to ensure we are an inclusive business, that will welcome and support you, from your initial application to wherever your career takes you! Please get in touch if you’d like to discuss any reasonable adjustments to your application, in order that we can accommodate and support you in the process. It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Our Program Managers
are responsible for leading enterprise level strategic initiatives and programs across the organization. These include complex initiatives that drive improvement, excellence, and results through management of several cross-functional teams.

Program Managers
have ownership from initiation of a strategic objective through delivery of specified measures of success to ensure the organization meets its goal. They apply advanced facilitation and analytical techniques to develop a deep understanding of processes and business needs to lead functional teams through a disciplined approach to execute on targeted objectives. They assist business leaders in managing change and act as agents of change throughout implementation of key business initiatives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Duties include but are not limited to:

Establish and lead high-visibility enterprise-wide, cross-functional strategic initiatives. Lead a variety of different types of projects including launching new products and services, application development, systems integration, operational efficiency improvements, process reengineering, and infrastructure upgrades and deployments. Oversees programs of many related projects to deliver value.
Single accountable party for defining, planning, orchestrating, and delivering a given strategic initiative. Ensures end results are of the highest caliber with a clearly articulated scope and quantifiable business benefit. Rigorously manages scope to ensure commitments are achieved within agreed on time, cost, and quality parameters.
Develops communication plans and interfaces to execute on responsibilities. Leads a continuous risk management process to identify and assess risks while developing and managing mitigation measures to minimize exposure to projects and the business.
Represents the project in various project governance and inter-department forums. Serve as point of contact for status of all assigned areas of focus.
Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree required, Master's Degree preferred
3 to 5+ years of experience in program management
Six Sigma Green Belt, Six Sigma Black Belt, or PMP Certification preferred
Knowledgeable and experienced in the research environment and healthcare processes
Experience leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives with large change impact
Complex program and project management skills
This position is hybrid in Nashville, TN.

Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Amentum Technology Inc. (ATI)
is the Large Business Team Lead for a newly awarded five-year contract in the Maryland area. The program delivers enterprise-wide cybersecurity and Risk Management Framework (RMF) support across the customer’s enterprise. The Deputy Program Manager (DPM)
provides executive-level leadership and operational oversight in support of a large, complex cybersecurity program. Reporting to the Program Manager, the DPM assists in directing all aspects of contract performance, including program execution, workforce management, financial management, schedule adherence, risk mitigation, customer relations, and quality assurance across multiple Prime Technical Task Orders (TTOs).

The DPM serves as a trusted advisor to the Program Manager and customer stakeholders, ensuring mission success through effective coordination of technical and operational teams, continuous process improvement, and disciplined program management practices. The DPM also serves as the designated alternate to the Program Manager and assumes leadership responsibilities as required.

Work Schedule:

In office, Monday–Friday, 5 days/week, 8 hours/day. Program hours are flexible within 0600–1800, core hours are 1000-1400. On-call availability required to support PMO surge events and incident response.

Essential Responsibilities:

As the senior operational leader, you will:

Lead day-to-day PMO operations across the contract teams; serve as deputy operational authority and trusted delegate to the Program Manager for execution decisions on cost, schedule, resource allocation, and customer engagement.
Develop and drive team workflows and processes.
Own monitoring, tracking, and reporting of performance, schedule, cost, and risk across all TTOs using software tools and analysis.
Manage the CDRL and non-CDRL deliverables portfolio, including Financial Report, Status, Compliance and Inventory.
Coordinate and facilitate the recurring PMO business tempo: Status Meetings, Standups, Monthly Status Reviews, and Quarterly Program Reviews.
Issue immediate verbal and written notification to the CO/COR within one working day of any event that may jeopardize cost, schedule, or technical performance.
Lead Capabilities/Needs List process to anticipate and resolve customer needs, long-term direction shifts, and mission surges
Coordinate requirements with the PMO functional team: TTO Leads, Contracts Manager, Subcontracts Manager, Finance/Accounting Lead, Recruiting, Program related Coordinator, CSSO, and Asset Manager.
Partner with the Finance Lead on EAC, accruals, invoicing, reporting, and limitation of funds notifications; ensure cost performance stays within funded ceilings.
Maintain the Contractor Position Roster Log (CPRL/eCPRL) in coordination with the CSSO.
Govern the Risk Register inside the shared PMO Portal; lead monthly risk review cadence, update mitigation owners, and elevate program-level risks to impacted parties and the customer.
Coordinate Government Furnished Property/Equipment (GFP/E), Materials & Procurement, Travel, Training, and Section 508 Compliance in partnership with TTO Leads PMO asset team, internal and external stakeholders.
Update the SOPs, Plans and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for incoming TTOs, surges, and contract-level changes.
Champion the ATI team and drive cooperation across the PMO team at ATI space, instill consistent processes, tools, and customer-facing deliverables.
Mentor junior PMO staff — including certification tracking, cross-training across MPO contracts, and career development planning.

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:

Position is performed on-site at ATI PMO facilities and customer site. (Columbia, MD, Hanover, and customer locations within 50-mile radius of Fort Meade, MD). Work is also performed inside a Secure Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) and requires extended periods at a workstation, frequent in-person and virtual stakeholder engagement, and sustained focus across concurrent technical and management priorities. Occasional after-hours and surge response is required. Travel: less than 10%, primarily local to customer and partner sites.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Demonstrated mastery of DoD/IC program management on Cost Plus Award Fee (CPAF) or comparable cost-reimbursable contracts.
Proven ability to manage several concurrent Technical Task Orders (TTOs), CDRL deliverables, and non-standard teaming structures such as JV, MFT or LSMFT.
Working knowledge of NIST RMF, authorization workflows, and cybersecurity service operations.
Strong financial and EVM literacy: EAC, BOE, FLHER, accruals, invoicing, award-fee management, and customer reporting (CDRs, QARs).
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, Power BI, ServiceNow, SharePoint, CostPoint and PMO collaboration tooling.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to brief senior internal and external leadership with composure and precision.
Detail-oriented, systems-thinker with a track record of building repeatable processes, dashboards, and management cadences that scale.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, mentor staff, and collaborate in a team environment.
Ability to maintain composure and decision quality during surge events, audits, and high-visibility customer escalations.

Clearance Required:
TS/SCI w/Poly

Minimum Education:

Bachelor's degree in information systems management, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Master's degree strongly preferred.

Minimum Years of Experience:

Ten (10) years of progressive program management experience supporting DoD or Intelligence Community customers, including a minimum of seven (7) years in a senior PMO leadership role on cleared cybersecurity, RMF, or cyber operations contracts. MPO program experience strongly preferred.

Required Certifications:

Must have a PMP, FAC-P/PM Senior Level, or Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Level 3 certification in Program Management.
Information Assurance Manager (IAM) Level II or III certification (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CASP+) strongly preferred to satisfy DoD 8140 / Cyberspace Workforce Improvement Program (CWIP) workforce coding.

Direct experience supporting Maryland Procurement Office (MPO)
Experience as Deputy Program Manager or Program Operations Manager on an LSMFT, JV, or multi-Prime construct with documented Small Business participation goals.
Experience operating or leading a collaborative Program Management structure.
Familiarity with CDRLS/ deliverables and MPO-specific reporting tools and deadlines.
Power BI dashboard design and ServiceNow workflow experience.
Demonstrated use of AI / generative AI tools to accelerate PMO operations — automated status reporting, deliverable drafting, risk register synthesis, and dashboard intelligence.
Master's degree in information systems management, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Computer Science, Management, or related field.
Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt or equivalent process-improvement credential.

Other Responsibilities:

- Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.

Crypto knowledge including Post Quantum,
Experience of setting up and running operational and exec level reporting capabilities, running a programme of improvements and team management/prioritisation to deliver that and stakeholder management to support it.

supports an Intelligence Office by administering and coordinating security activities for Special Access Programs that enable critical intelligence, technical, and operational missions supporting counter-Unmanned Systems (UXS) efforts. Working closely with the Government Special Security Officer (GSSO), operational personnel, technical teams, and external mission partners, the PSM ensures compliance with SAP, SCI, and collateral security requirements while maintaining operational responsiveness in a dynamic mission environment.

The ideal candidate possesses extensive knowledge of Special Access Program security requirements, security administration, classified information protection, personnel security processes, and facility security operations. This individual serves as a trusted security professional who enables mission success by balancing stringent security requirements with operational effectiveness.

Responsibilities

Provide day-to-day security support and administration for assigned Special Access Programs within an Intelligence Office.
Coordinate and process personnel security actions, access requests, indoctrinations, debriefings, transfers, and visit certifications in accordance with government security requirements.
Maintain records and documentation related to personnel access, security clearances, classified holdings, and program participation.

Coordinate with Government Special Security Officers, security managers, contractors, program managers, and external security offices to resolve access, classification, facility, and security-related issues.
Ensure proper safeguarding, storage, transmission, transportation, and destruction of classified information and materials.
Support classified meetings, operational activities, and program events requiring enhanced security coordination and oversight.
Assist with security incident reporting, inquiry support, and implementation of corrective actions.
Conduct document accountability activities and maintain accurate records associated with classified program materials.
Support security education, awareness training, and briefings for personnel assigned to SAP activities.

Experience coordinating across multiple government agencies, commands, and external mission partners.
Knowledge of classified facility operations, secure communications, and controlled access environments.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Ability to work onsite in Arlington or Alexandria, Virginia.
Knowledge of government security regulations, directives, and procedures governing classified programs.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to protecting sensitive information.
Ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling classified and compartmented information.
Ability to work independently and as part of an integrated team supporting national security missions.

How you’ll grow

At Chenega MIOS, our professional development plan focuses on helping our team members at every level of their careers to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. 

We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their careers. 

Benefits

At Chenega MIOS, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our team members and offer them a broad range of benefits. 

Learn more about what working at Chenega MIOS can mean for you.

Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst

Global Knowledge Base | Enterprise Customer Experience

The Role

The Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst
plays a critical role in transforming Clarios’ Global Knowledge Base (GKB) from a traditional content and data repository into a globally connected, AI-enabled, and insight-driven enterprise capability.

Working closely with the Global Knowledge Sr. Manager
, this role prepares, structures, analyzes, and translates customer, product, market, operational, and knowledge data into actionable insights that improve customer experience, support regional growth, and enable new business opportunities.

The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations.

What You’ll Do (Impact Areas)

Data Analysis & Business Insights

Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness.
Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities.
Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making.

Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics

Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance.
Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness.
Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact.

Data Products & Value Creation

Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions.
Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions.
Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential.
Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value.

Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance

Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data.
Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements.
Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes.
Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions.

AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics

Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem.
Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities.
Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support.
Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities.

Business & Technology Partnership

Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements.
Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions.
Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner.
Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes.

Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement

Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products.
Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions.
Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation.
Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value.

What Success Looks Like

Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases.
Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making.
Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance.
Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions.
AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity.
Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem.
Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams.
Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth.

Core Competencies

Data analysis and analytical thinking.
Business intelligence and data visualization.
Data storytelling and executive communication.
Business requirements gathering and translation.
Problem-solving and root cause analysis.
Data quality and governance.
AI and digital technology awareness.
Customer-centric thinking.
Cross-functional collaboration.
Stakeholder management and influence.
Business and commercial acumen.
Continuous improvement mindset.
Project coordination and execution.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity.

Required

What You Bring (Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions.
Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources.
Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements.
Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment.
Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools.

Preferred

Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives.
Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions.
Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation.
Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments.
Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics.
Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants.
Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations.
Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products.

Work Model & Travel

Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements.
Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization.
Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs.
Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams.

Our Commitment to You

Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of a global, AI-enabled Knowledge Management capability.
Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products.
Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions.
Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders.
A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable business impact.
Opportunities for professional growth while helping turn enterprise data and knowledge into capabilities that improve customer experience and create long-term business value.

Clarios is the global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. With around 18,000 employees in over 100 countries, we bring deep expertise to our Aftermarket and OEM partners, and reliability, safety and comfort to everyday lives. jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking, proactive defenders for a critical role safeguarding the nation's most sensitive digital landscapes. As a Cyber Security Analyst on our 24x7 front-line security operations team, you will be directly responsible for defending mission environments against the world's sophisticated and persistent cyber threats. This role demands exceptional critical thinking, a deep-seated adversary mindset, and a self-motivated drive to excel in a high-stakes mission.

Primary Responsibilities

Conduct investigation and triage of security alerts from endpoints, IDS/IPS, NetFlow, and custom sensors to identify and neutralize threats within our mission spaces.
Perform deep-dive analysis of extensive, highly-classified log files, pivoting between disparate datasets and correlating evidence to support complex incident investigations against nation-state actors.
Produce detailed technical findings and reports for high-level stakeholders, documenting adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Integrate and operationalize highly-classified threat intelligence feeds and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) into security sensors and SIEM platforms.
Collaborate closely with specialized incident response teams and ensure timely, precise communication of security incidents to mission partners.

Key Skillsets We Are Looking For

SOC Experience: You understand the operational flow, high tempo demands, and rigorous standards of a 24x7 Security Operations Center, particularly those operating at the highest classification levels.
Critical Thinking & Adversary Mindset: You possess the ability to look beyond the surface of an alert to uncover the TTPs of advanced persistent threats (APTs). You excel at correlating disparate data points, analyzing raw packet data, and conducting deep-dive investigations of complex security events.
Demonstrated Self-Motivation: You are a self-starter who takes active ownership of your professional development. Whether pursuing advanced certifications, researching emerging threat vectors, or mastering new tools, you drive your own growth to stay ahead of the adversary.
Thrives on Change: The threat landscape and tactical priorities shift constantly. You demonstrate high operational adaptability, viewing unexpected shifts as opportunities to excel, and seamlessly pivot to adopt new processes, security tools, and analytical methodologies.

Shift & Operational Requirements

Predictable Work-Life Balance: To support your well-being, we utilize a predictable five-day, 8-hour shift structure.
Shift Options to Fit Your Lifestyle: Our 24x7 mission requires continuous coverage, but it also provides the opportunity to align your work hours with your personal routine. Key coverage windows include:
Day Shift: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
Swing Shift: 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM
Mid Shift: 12:00 AM - 8:00 AM
Flexibility: We highly value your work-life balance and make every effort to honor your shift preferences whenever possible. While final assignments must ensure critical program requirements are met, we strive to manage scheduling with a balanced approach that respects our team members' personal needs alongside mission readiness.

Required Qualifications

Clearance: Must have an active DoD Top Secret security clearance.
Baseline Certification: Current DoD 8570 IAT Level II (or higher) certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, ISC2 SSCP, or SANS GSEC (or equivalent 8140 requirements).
Specialized Certification: Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 CSSP-Analyst level certification (e.g., CEH, CySA+, GCIA, or equivalent) within 180 days of hire.
Technical Core: Solid foundation in networking principles, including packet analysis, common ports/protocols, traffic flow, the OSI model, and defense-in-depth architecture.
Experience & Education:
Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience (Equivalent professional work or military experience will be considered in lieu of a degree)
Location: Commutable distance (within 2 hours) or ability to self-relocate to Scott AFB, IL.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience working within a TS/SCI operational environment, DISA, or other specialized DoD agencies.
Experience applying intelligence-driven defense strategies utilizing the MITRE ATT&CK or Cyber Kill Chain frameworks against known APT intrusion sets.
In-depth experience utilizing SIEM/SOAR platforms to perform behavioral and statistical analysis across multiple log types within a classified network.
Knowledge or experience in defending classified cloud environments (e.g., AWS Secret/Top Secret, Azure Government Secret/Top Secret).
Basic scripting and programming skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate routine analytical tasks.

Are you a highly motivated, compassionate and dedicated individual looking for a rewarding career assisting the most vulnerable citizens of Texas in need of food, medical care, cash assistance and other social services?

If so, the Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) Access and Eligibility Services (AES) division is looking for individuals who want to join an exciting, dynamic team working in a high-performing and innovative environment. AES provides an integrated and streamlined approach to connect individuals to services and supports that: reduce institutionalization, allow individuals to remain in their communities, and promote economic and personal self-sufficiency. AES is built upon its’ core values of respect, ownership, collaboration, and integrity with a goal of delivering best-in-class customer service to clients and stakeholders.

Our staff are well organized, able to multi-task, possess the ability to learn policy regulations, able to thrive in a challenging, fast-paced, and evolving environment, have good communication skills, a positive attitude, strong work-ethic and a desire to help others. If you also possess these skills, then we are looking for you.

We want you to join our team!

Responsible for providing program and technical assistance, as well as coaching and development of team supervisors, workers, and clerical staff.
