new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery - Remote
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Project Manager for our Power Delivery Project Management team located in Rochester, NY; Syracuse, NY; New York City, NY; Boston, MA; Portland, ME; or Newark, NJ.

The candidate may work from a mutually acceptable location within the region and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings. The successful candidate will be responsible for initiating and executing Power Delivery projects, managing and developing client relationships, and marketing WSP’s Power Delivery services to existing and new clients in the respective region.

This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
May participate, and at times, lead the contract negotiations and client presentations
Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan.
Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
Provide guidance and mentoring to other staff.
Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market.
12 years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry
Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.
Minimum of 5 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects.
Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:
Contract Management
External and Internal Team Meeting Management
Earned Value Management
Change Management
Risk Management
Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
Financial Management

Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
Occasional travel is required and travel frequency will depend on client and project-specific requirements.

WSP Benefits

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.
Compensation:
Expected Salary (all locations): $180,000-$245,000
WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

Drive tangible and sustainable improvement in PM capabilities.
Assist with business development activities to grow Insight Services business.

This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

Skills in all aspects of project management lifecycle and critical processes:
Project Initiation

Resource Management
Budget Management
Stakeholder Management

Risk Management
Must be passionate about continuous improvement.
Must be able to manage technical resources working on multiple projects seamlessly.
Must be an excellent communicator - both written and oral.
Must have excellent customer relationship management skills.

What You Can Expect

We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family and to help you engage with your local community.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

Join us today, your ambITious journey starts here.

new_jobs.description:
Project Manager, Utility Scale Solar

Location
– Remote US

Job Summary

The Project Manager is a newly created opportunity within a prominent fast-growing renewable energy developer, project owner, and IPP with over 3 GW of solar and battery projects. This full-time opportunity will join a nationally recognized leadership team and be responsible for working with multiple internal project teams to manage large scale, complex solar and battery storage projects to meet essential metrics for safety, quality, schedule, and financial performance. The PM is the primary point of contact for clients and other external stakeholders, while leading internal teams to execute the projects successfully. The Project Manager opportunity will offer a competitive compensation package comprised of a base salary in the $155,000 to $165,000 range, a 25% annual bonus target, excellent benefits, and strong career mobility potential within the company’s rapidly scaled growth track. This position will offer a fully remote work schedule however candidates must be able to travel domestically as needed.

Project Manager – Job Description

Plan, execute, monitor, control and close out and complete turn-key PV and battery storage projects and portfolios of high complexity and corresponding challenges
Serve as a key point of contact for clear, accurate and timely communications to management and key stakeholders
Create and manage budgets to provide effective financial control for the project activities; Support cost reduction efforts and actively participate in cost reviews
Develop and manage project schedules to track process of the work, identify and mitigate potential problems, accelerate velocity, and provide accurate reporting of actual and forecasted dates
Develop and implement comprehensive risk management strategies based on thorough understanding of the work and realistic means to mitigate exposure
Read contract agreements and develop a detailed understanding of the requirements; Ensure that the project team works to fulfill all contract requirements and minimize the potential for disputes and conflicts.
Coordinate design and permitting activities with the project development and execution team and local authorities
Develop a schedule and manage the activities for material procurement with the Procurement team; Develop schedule and manage activities for contracting, including developing scopes and contract documents.
Effectively oversee all construction activities and schedules with field operations and contractors to ensure alignment with production targets, phasing, staging and logistics; Ensure the safety and quality of the delivered projects in compliance with company standards.

Project Manager – Job Qualifications

5+ years construction and project management experience; demonstrated experience with utility scale solar EPC
BS in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred

Company Overview

COME JOIN OUR JOURNEY!

When you join TT, you join our global community of visionaries, creators, and achievers dedicated to engineering and manufacturing electronic solutions enabling a safer, healthier and more sustainable world. Simply put, we are a global manufacturer with a passion for engineering advanced electronics that benefit our planet and people for future generations. We are committed to having a positive impact on the world through a culture built around safety, transparency, collaboration, and positive relationships. Our teams are fueled by performance and expertise, leading the charge in innovation, efficiency and delivering world-class customer service. Be part of the journey.

Role Overview And Responsibilities

Introduction

The Program Manager serves as TT Electronics’ primary point of contact and interface with the customer, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and coordination across all aspects of the customer relationship. The Program Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the assigned customer accounts, including but not limited to, revenue performance, profitability, order excellence, and the overall customer experience . The Program Manager ensures cross-functional alignment across TT teams, drives effective program execution, and maintains a high level of customer satisfaction.

This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary customer focal point, providing comprehensive oversight of the Customer-TT Electronics relationship while supporting existing and new opportunities for business growth.

Direct and lead the Customer-Focused Team in day-to-day activities, driving timely and effective conflict resolution and proactively identifying and addressing opportunities for continuous improvement.
Serve as the “Voice of the Customer” within TT Electronics by maintaining a comprehensive understanding of customer programs, requirements, priorities, and risks, while ensuring these are effectively communicated across the organization and cross-functional teams.
Accountability for the accuracy, timely maintenance, and effective communication of schedules, order books, forecasts, and contract requirements.
Understand, or possess the ability learn, finance acumen including but not limited to, gross margin, operating profit, and pricing cost structures.
Accountable and responsible for the financial performance of assigned products and customer accounts, including, but not limited to, pricing, profitability, PPV, gross margin, material liabilities, on-time delivery, quality, and cost-savings opportunities
Accountable and responsible in maintaining working knowledge of contract (Supply Agreement) requirements while proactively managing financial risk and liability to TT Electronics.
Prepare and present regular business updates for internal Account Reviews, customer Business Reviews, and other forums as required.
Leverage a comprehensive understanding of customer needs and requirements to support Senior Leadership in the development of annual sales plans, budgets, and related business planning activities.
Travel to customer sites, as well as lead internal visits, in support of business reviews, relationship management, and program requirements.
Demonstrate active involvement in and support of TT Electronics’ health and safety, compliance, and quality management systems.
Support Account Managers in the overall success and growth of assigned accounts.

Core Requirements

Qualifications, Skills and Attributes

Education/Experience/Credentials: Bachelor’s Degree or two to four years’ combined experience and training/education. Experience managing highly regulated industries (Medical, Aerospace, Defense) and/or industry certifications is a plus.
Language Ability : Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to read and analyze periodicals, business reports, correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to write clear and professional reports, business correspondence, and procedural documentation. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, team members, and the public. The individual must demonstrate strong grammar, editing, and proofreading skills.
Math Ability: Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.
Reasoning Ability: Ability to collect and analyze data, solve practical problems, and work effectively with a variety of concrete variables in situations where limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret instructions presented in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Must consistently maintain a professional and positive image in all situations while exercising sound judgment.
Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office with emphasis on Excel & SharePoint. Familiar with ERP systems, Business Intelligence portals, etc. Basic Sales Force knowledge is a plus.
Supervisory Responsibilities: None.
Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The employee may be required to work from a home office and must ensure that the workspace is appropriately equipped to support a professional, distraction‑free environment. The individual must be able to self‑supervise and manage time effectively to meet company expectations. The noise level in the work environment is typically quiet
Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include the ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers for dexterity; handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; and communicate effectively. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stand; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
Travel Requirements: Sufficient travel will be required to support job functions, 10% to 20% of your time is the expectancy to support our business.
Training requirements : Team members will be required to attend various training classes to ensure adequate knowledge of company specific information, customer, regulatory, and other requirements as determined by job process, standard operating procedures or other elements as required.

This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), which means that limitations relating to nationality may apply.

Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Our Program Managers
are responsible for leading enterprise level strategic initiatives and programs across the organization. These include complex initiatives that drive improvement, excellence, and results through management of several cross-functional teams.

Program Managers
have ownership from initiation of a strategic objective through delivery of specified measures of success to ensure the organization meets its goal. They apply advanced facilitation and analytical techniques to develop a deep understanding of processes and business needs to lead functional teams through a disciplined approach to execute on targeted objectives. They assist business leaders in managing change and act as agents of change throughout implementation of key business initiatives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Duties include but are not limited to:

Establish and lead high-visibility enterprise-wide, cross-functional strategic initiatives. Lead a variety of different types of projects including launching new products and services, application development, systems integration, operational efficiency improvements, process reengineering, and infrastructure upgrades and deployments. Oversees programs of many related projects to deliver value.
Single accountable party for defining, planning, orchestrating, and delivering a given strategic initiative. Ensures end results are of the highest caliber with a clearly articulated scope and quantifiable business benefit. Rigorously manages scope to ensure commitments are achieved within agreed on time, cost, and quality parameters.
Develops communication plans and interfaces to execute on responsibilities. Leads a continuous risk management process to identify and assess risks while developing and managing mitigation measures to minimize exposure to projects and the business.
Represents the project in various project governance and inter-department forums. Serve as point of contact for status of all assigned areas of focus.
Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree required, Master's Degree preferred
3 to 5+ years of experience in program management
Six Sigma Green Belt, Six Sigma Black Belt, or PMP Certification preferred
Knowledgeable and experienced in the research environment and healthcare processes
Experience leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives with large change impact
Complex program and project management skills
This position is hybrid in Nashville, TN.

Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Client & Public Relations: Maintain positive relationships with current and past clients. Represent the company at meetings, presentations, and public hearings relative to assigned projects.
Team Development: Mentor and develop less experienced engineering and management staff, training them on industry standards and technologies.
Operations: Manage multiple teams and projects simultaneously, both remotely and within local offices.

Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst

Global Knowledge Base | Enterprise Customer Experience

The Role

The Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst
plays a critical role in transforming Clarios’ Global Knowledge Base (GKB) from a traditional content and data repository into a globally connected, AI-enabled, and insight-driven enterprise capability.

Working closely with the Global Knowledge Sr. Manager
, this role prepares, structures, analyzes, and translates customer, product, market, operational, and knowledge data into actionable insights that improve customer experience, support regional growth, and enable new business opportunities.

The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations.

What You’ll Do (Impact Areas)

Data Analysis & Business Insights

Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness.
Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities.
Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making.

Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics

Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance.
Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness.
Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact.

Data Products & Value Creation

Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions.
Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions.
Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential.
Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value.

Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance

Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data.
Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements.
Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes.
Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions.

AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics

Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem.
Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities.
Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support.
Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities.

Business & Technology Partnership

Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements.
Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions.
Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner.
Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes.

Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement

Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products.
Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions.
Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation.
Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value.

What Success Looks Like

Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases.
Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making.
Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance.
Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions.
AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity.
Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem.
Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams.
Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth.

Core Competencies

Data analysis and analytical thinking.
Business intelligence and data visualization.
Data storytelling and executive communication.
Business requirements gathering and translation.
Problem-solving and root cause analysis.
Data quality and governance.
AI and digital technology awareness.
Customer-centric thinking.
Cross-functional collaboration.
Stakeholder management and influence.
Business and commercial acumen.
Continuous improvement mindset.
Project coordination and execution.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity.

Required

What You Bring (Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions.
Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources.
Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements.
Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment.
Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools.

Preferred

Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives.
Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions.
Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation.
Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments.
Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics.
Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants.
Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations.
Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products.

Work Model & Travel

Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements.
Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization.
Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs.
Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams.

Our Commitment to You

Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of a global, AI-enabled Knowledge Management capability.
Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products.
Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions.
Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking, proactive defenders for a critical role safeguarding the nation's most sensitive digital landscapes. As a Cyber Security Analyst on our 24x7 front-line security operations team, you will be directly responsible for defending mission environments against the world's sophisticated and persistent cyber threats. This role demands exceptional critical thinking, a deep-seated adversary mindset, and a self-motivated drive to excel in a high-stakes mission.

Primary Responsibilities

Conduct investigation and triage of security alerts from endpoints, IDS/IPS, NetFlow, and custom sensors to identify and neutralize threats within our mission spaces.
Perform deep-dive analysis of extensive, highly-classified log files, pivoting between disparate datasets and correlating evidence to support complex incident investigations against nation-state actors.
Produce detailed technical findings and reports for high-level stakeholders, documenting adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Integrate and operationalize highly-classified threat intelligence feeds and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) into security sensors and SIEM platforms.
Collaborate closely with specialized incident response teams and ensure timely, precise communication of security incidents to mission partners.

Key Skillsets We Are Looking For

SOC Experience: You understand the operational flow, high tempo demands, and rigorous standards of a 24x7 Security Operations Center, particularly those operating at the highest classification levels.
Critical Thinking & Adversary Mindset: You possess the ability to look beyond the surface of an alert to uncover the TTPs of advanced persistent threats (APTs). You excel at correlating disparate data points, analyzing raw packet data, and conducting deep-dive investigations of complex security events.
Demonstrated Self-Motivation: You are a self-starter who takes active ownership of your professional development. Whether pursuing advanced certifications, researching emerging threat vectors, or mastering new tools, you drive your own growth to stay ahead of the adversary.
Thrives on Change: The threat landscape and tactical priorities shift constantly. You demonstrate high operational adaptability, viewing unexpected shifts as opportunities to excel, and seamlessly pivot to adopt new processes, security tools, and analytical methodologies.

Shift & Operational Requirements

Predictable Work-Life Balance: To support your well-being, we utilize a predictable five-day, 8-hour shift structure.
Shift Options to Fit Your Lifestyle: Our 24x7 mission requires continuous coverage, but it also provides the opportunity to align your work hours with your personal routine. Key coverage windows include:
Day Shift: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
Swing Shift: 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM
Mid Shift: 12:00 AM - 8:00 AM
Flexibility: We highly value your work-life balance and make every effort to honor your shift preferences whenever possible. While final assignments must ensure critical program requirements are met, we strive to manage scheduling with a balanced approach that respects our team members' personal needs alongside mission readiness.

Required Qualifications

Clearance: Must have an active DoD Top Secret security clearance.
Baseline Certification: Current DoD 8570 IAT Level II (or higher) certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, ISC2 SSCP, or SANS GSEC (or equivalent 8140 requirements).
Specialized Certification: Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 CSSP-Analyst level certification (e.g., CEH, CySA+, GCIA, or equivalent) within 180 days of hire.
Technical Core: Solid foundation in networking principles, including packet analysis, common ports/protocols, traffic flow, the OSI model, and defense-in-depth architecture.
Experience & Education:
Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience (Equivalent professional work or military experience will be considered in lieu of a degree)
Location: Commutable distance (within 2 hours) or ability to self-relocate to Scott AFB, IL.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience working within a TS/SCI operational environment, DISA, or other specialized DoD agencies.
Experience applying intelligence-driven defense strategies utilizing the MITRE ATT&CK or Cyber Kill Chain frameworks against known APT intrusion sets.
In-depth experience utilizing SIEM/SOAR platforms to perform behavioral and statistical analysis across multiple log types within a classified network.
Knowledge or experience in defending classified cloud environments (e.g., AWS Secret/Top Secret, Azure Government Secret/Top Secret).
Basic scripting and programming skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate routine analytical tasks.

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills and Competencies

0-2 years’ experience in credit/financial data analysis and interpretation with knowledge of capital markets; experience in structured finance will be an added advantage
Skilled in identifying key credit risk factors and applying relevant credit methodologies to support analysis and decision-making.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
Detail-oriented and well-organized, with a proven ability to excel in team-driven environments.
Basic understanding of AI concepts (Generative AI tools and Agentic AI systems), with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency leveraging these technologies for research, analysis, or workflow optimization. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.
Experience with data science and analytics tools like Python, Power BI, and Alteryx is advantageous along with proficiency in handling large datasets, ensuring data integrity, and applying best practices in data analysis

Education

Masters’ degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics from or qualified CA
CFA/FRM certification is preferred.

Responsibilities

Independently manage routine deliverables such as portfolio review preparation, credit opinions, and outreach materials, while contributing to process improvement initiatives.
Apply Moody’s ratings methodologies to create adjusted data, key indicators, ratios, charts, and graphs that enhance ratings and research accuracy.
Perform data intake, scrubbing, and validation to ensure accuracy and readiness for research and ratings processes.
Analyze financial reports, official statements, and related documents to assess issuer performance and creditworthiness.Partner with analysts and accounting specialists to apply relevant accounting concepts and capture accurate data for ratings.
Provide direction and resolve queries for junior team members to ensure quality and efficiency in deliverables.

About The Team

Being part of the RRS Global Capability Centers provides a unique opportunity to foster skills that are valuable to any future career in the financial services industry. The RRS GCC teams perform a range of data, analytical and research services that contribute to the overall credit analysis function performed by the rating groups. By joining our team, you will be a part of exciting work in the global capability centers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Brief Job Description

Are you a highly motivated, compassionate and dedicated individual looking for a rewarding career assisting the most vulnerable citizens of Texas in need of food, medical care, cash assistance and other social services?

If so, the Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) Access and Eligibility Services (AES) division is looking for individuals who want to join an exciting, dynamic team working in a high-performing and innovative environment. AES provides an integrated and streamlined approach to connect individuals to services and supports that: reduce institutionalization, allow individuals to remain in their communities, and promote economic and personal self-sufficiency. AES is built upon its’ core values of respect, ownership, collaboration, and integrity with a goal of delivering best-in-class customer service to clients and stakeholders.

Our staff are well organized, able to multi-task, possess the ability to learn policy regulations, able to thrive in a challenging, fast-paced, and evolving environment, have good communication skills, a positive attitude, strong work-ethic and a desire to help others. If you also possess these skills, then we are looking for you.

We want you to join our team!

The Program Manager manages eligibility unit supervisors at benefit offices and out stationed sites. Responsible for providing program and technical assistance, as well as coaching and development of team supervisors, workers, and clerical staff. Work involves planning, developing, implementing, and monitoring Access and Eligibility Services programs. Works under general direction with extensive latitude for use of initiative and independent judgment. Job requires highly driven individuals with a high degree of ethics and integrity, good communication, interpersonal and analytical skills, and the ability to make effective decisions. This position may require up to 40% of travel.

Review and approves all staffing and personnel actions, evaluates program operations to recommend modifications and develop efficiencies when needed and provides a variety of narrative and statistical reports regarding performance standards and staffing needs.

Selects, manages, and develops staff through conferences, mentoring, training, and performance appraisal.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Security Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job type: Full-time

Location: Hybrid - Newark, CA

Reports to: VP of Supply Chain Operations

Salary: $125K – $160K DOE

Wintec Industries is seeking an experienced Supply Chain Security Program Manager
to lead the day-to-day governance, enforcement, and continuous improvement of our supply chain security program.
Reporting to the VP of Supply Chain Operations, this role will serve as the subject matter expert for transportation and cargo security, warehouse and facility security, 3PL security, compliance, audits, and security risk management across Wintec’s global supply chain network.

This is a hands-on program management role focused on protecting high-value inventory and shipments while ensuring security requirements are practical, consistently implemented, documented, and auditable.

What You’ll Do -

Supply Chain Security Governance

Administer and maintain Wintec’s Supply Chain Security Program, policies, standards, SOPs, checklists, and security requirements.
Translate customer, insurance, contractual, and company security requirements into practical operational controls.
Establish and maintain security qualification requirements for warehouses, 3PLs, carriers, freight brokers, monitoring providers, escort providers, and other security-sensitive partners.
Verify compliance with required security controls and manage security exceptions and escalations.
Maintain documentation and evidence to support customer, insurance, internal, and third-party reviews.

Transportation & Cargo Security

Manage security requirements for high-value/high-risk (HVHR) shipments, including carrier qualification, driver and vehicle verification, GPS tracking, geofencing, route controls, authorized stops, locks/seals, escorts, monitoring, and proof of delivery.
Conduct or coordinate transportation lane risk assessments based on cargo value, route, geography, theft exposure, and customer or insurance requirements.
Verify required security controls before shipment release and escalate or block activities that do not meet established requirements.
Evaluate transportation security performance and recommend improvements to controls, providers, monitoring methods, and technology.

Facility, Warehouse & 3PL Security

Administer and verify physical security requirements for company and third-party warehouse locations.
Assess security controls such as access control, CCTV, alarms, lighting, guard services, restricted areas, dock security, inventory protection, and visitor/vendor access.
Coordinate security due diligence for new warehouses, 3PL providers, expansions, and significant operational changes.
Verify that appropriate controls are in place to protect high-value inventory from theft, tampering, unauthorized access, and loss.

Audit, Compliance & Corrective Action

Develop and maintain a risk-based security audit and assurance schedule.
Conduct security reviews and coordinate third-party security audits.
Document findings, risk levels, corrective actions, responsible owners, and remediation timelines.
Maintain and follow up on Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) items.
Support customer security assessments, insurer reviews, and other security-related due diligence.

Security Incident Support

Support the VP of Supply Chain Operations and other leadership during cargo theft, inventory loss, tampering, unauthorized access, tracking failures, and other significant security incidents.
Coordinate collection and preservation of evidence such as GPS records, CCTV footage, BOLs, PODs, access records, driver/vehicle information, photographs, and security logs.
Support root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are incorporated into procedures, controls, training, and partner requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams, 3PLs, carriers, brokers, customers, insurers, law enforcement, investigators, and security consultants as needed.

Training & Continuous Improvement

Develop practical security training and awareness materials for employees and relevant external partners.
Monitor supply chain security standards, practices, and emerging cargo-theft risks.
Recommend improvements to security controls, technologies, service providers, audit methods, and training.

What We’re Looking For -

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Criminal Justice, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
5+ years of experience
in supply chain security, transportation/cargo security, corporate security, asset protection, loss prevention, logistics security, or a closely related field.
Experience working with warehouses, 3PL providers, transportation providers, freight brokers, and/or complex supply chain operations.
Experience administering security procedures, conducting security audits or risk assessments, verifying operational compliance, and managing corrective actions.
Working knowledge of transportation security, cargo-theft prevention, physical security, and high-value/high-risk cargo protection.
Ability to identify security vulnerabilities and translate requirements into practical operational controls.
Strong analytical, documentation, project management, investigation support, and communication skills.
Ability to enforce standards and influence internal teams and external partners without direct reporting authority.
Ability to travel approximately 20–30%
, including domestic and occasional international travel.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience protecting high-value electronics, semiconductor components, technology products, pharmaceuticals, or other high-value/high-risk commodities.
Familiarity with TAPA FSR/TSR, CTPAT, ISO 28000 principles, ISO 17712
, or similar supply chain security frameworks.
Experience with GPS shipment tracking, geofencing, cargo monitoring, CCTV, access control, high-security seals, escort services, and related security technologies.
Experience supporting cargo theft/loss investigations, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Experience working with insurers, customers, security consultants, law enforcement, or third-party investigators.

Overview

The Senior Project Manager (PM II) is responsible for leading the planning, governance, coordination, and execution of the Secrets Exposure Analytics and Escalation Program. This role drives cross-functional initiatives across Cybersecurity & Digital Trust, Human Resources, business stakeholders, and technical teams to establish and operationalize capabilities for identifying, validating, escalating, and remediating exposed secrets and credential-related risks.

(1) Program Planning & Roadmap Management

Establish, maintain, and drive execution of the Secrets Exposure Analytics & Escalation Program roadmap.
Define project scope, objectives, milestones, timelines, success criteria, and key deliverables.
Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify schedule, scope, or execution risks.

(2) Governance & Execution Management

Establish and maintain program governance structures, operating rhythms, and decision-making processes.
Develop governance documentation, meeting cadences, and stakeholder engagement plans.
Facilitate recurring working sessions, project reviews, stakeholder forums, and leadership updates.

(3) Secrets Exposure Workflow Oversight

Coordinate the end-to-end workflow supporting exposed secret detection, validation, notification, escalation, remediation, and closure activities.
Partner with operational and technical teams to ensure processes are well-defined, documented, and consistently executed.
Monitor workflow effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and accountability.

(4) Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Maintain comprehensive RAID logs and ensure risks, issues, and dependencies are actively managed.
Identify, document, assess, and communicate project risks and mitigation strategies.
Facilitate issue resolution and coordinate corrective actions with accountable stakeholders.

(5) Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Define and track program KPIs and operational effectiveness metrics.

What the Role Does

Turn data into better product decisions.
As a Business Data Analyst, you will partner with Product Owners to design experiments, analyze customer behaviour, and turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Your work will influence product roadmaps across key customer journeys, including conversion, engagement, and renewals.
You will go beyond reporting results. You will apply statistical rigour, investigate unexpected findings, challenge assumptions constructively, and uncover opportunities that improve the customer experience and business performance. This role is for a curious, proactive analyst who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of analytical initiatives, and turns insights into meaningful action to uncover opportunities and strengthen how we measure, report, and make decisions across the business.

What You’ll Do

Build dashboards and automated reports to improve accessibility and insight quality
Translate business questions into measurable metrics
Deliver data based recommendations and clearly identify actionable next steps
Improve tracking plans, event quality, and attribution logic to ensure accurate and reliable measurement
Write and optimize SQL queries and notebooks to support analysis
Communicate data analysis results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders
Collaborate with fellow analysts to review results, refine methodologies, and strengthen analytical approaches

What You Bring

Post-secondary education in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or other related programs
3+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or data science

Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex analysis clearly

Experience analyzing and designing A/B experiments
Ability to structure ambiguous problems into analytical plans
Confidence challenging assumptions while maintaining strong working relationships
Proactive mindset that goes beyond answering questions to identifying new opportunities
Comfortable presenting insights to Product Owners and leadership

Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

About The Role

Data Analyst, Spotlight Listings

Are you a marketplace analytics expert? Are you ready to own the commercial measurement engine behind one of real estate's most visible listing-promotion products? If you want to pursue your professional goals as you help grow an innovative real estate tech company, this work is for you. Join us as our newest Data Analyst, Seller and help change the world of real estate, one home at a time.

Top Reasons To Apply

End-to-end ownership: You'd own the full measurement framework for a live product line — KPIs, dashboards, and instrumentation, not just contribute analyses to someone else's model.
Solve High-Complexity Marketplace Problems: This is a playground for advanced analytics. You will tackle non-trivial, two-sided marketplace challenges including pricing/packaging optimization and causal inference for interventions where standard A/B test assumptions often break down.
Strategic Executive Visibility: Because Spotlight Listing a growth area for the next few years, this role offers high exposure to high-profile stakeholders. You won't just be presenting charts; you will be partnering with Product, Marketing, and Sales to shape commercial decisions and drive measurable product impact..

What You’ll Do

Design and own the canonical performance measurement framework for Spotlight Listings — defining the KPIs that actually reflect product health at scale, building the SSOT dashboards that leadership and FP&A rely on weekly, and setting the instrumentation specs that make every new SPL surface measurable from day one
Build and maintain the inventory capacity model that determines token caps at the market level, calibrated against impression share and uplift targets, and partner with Sales to operationalize those limits as durable guardrails in Salesforce
Lead experimental design for SPL pricing, packaging, and renewal interventions — scoping tests with adequate statistical power, selecting the right estimators for a two-sided marketplace setting, and delivering readouts that are defensible at the executive level and actionable for the product team
Own SPL revenue and activation reporting end-to-end: weekly pacing for leadership, monthly inputs for FP&A, pack and subscription-level economics, and analytical support for enterprise agreements and Teams pricing pilots
Drive data quality and pipeline integrity across all SPL assets, investigating and resolving issues at root cause, coordinating with Engineering and the data platform team to close structural gaps permanently, and maintaining Tier 1 reliability standards
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales on pricing and packaging decisions, including a-la-carte vs. pack economics, guest checkout funnel conversion, and token-utilization patterns that predict renewal risk and inform proactive account outreach.

What You'll Bring

2+ years of experience in data science or quantitative analytics, with a track record of owning a product or business unit's measurement framework end-to-end — not just contributing analyses to someone else's model
Deep fluency in causal inference and experimental design, including experience with marketplace or two-sided platform settings where standard A/B assumptions require adjustment
Advanced SQL and Python skills applied to large-scale clickstream and transaction data; experience with Snowflake and dbt strongly preferred
Demonstrated ability to translate analytical findings into commercial decisions, with evidence that your recommendations were adopted and had measurable revenue or product impact
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree a plus

How We Work

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You

Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays

Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location

Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. Our mission is to help millions of investors achieve better results in the markets. This is your chance to work at the intersection of investing, AI, and product, alongside other exceptional engineers and investors, and help define what modern equity research looks like.

Job Description

StockStory, a newly acquired part of CNBC, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We continue operating like a startup: small team, high ownership, fast decisions, direct access to leadership, and a culture focused on building rather than managing.

Our mission is to help millions of investors achieve better results in the markets. This is your chance to work at the intersection of investing, AI, and product, alongside other exceptional engineers and investors, and help define what modern equity research looks like.

We're looking for a highly driven and intellectually curious equity analyst to join our team to build a new generation of AI-powered equity research. You will be working on a small, high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering, product, and buy-side talent, including senior analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR.

This role is designed for investors who still want to apply and sharpen their fundamental research judgment, but who are more excited by building scalable systems than by repeating the same research process company by company, quarter after quarter. It is especially well suited to people who want to future-proof their investing career by learning how great equity analysis gets translated into software, models, and AI-enabled products.

You will be instrumental to the team that builds and operates core components of our AI equity research engine: LLM workflows that convert unstructured information into structured signals, and factor models that turn those signals into consistent, scalable outputs for individual investors.

This role sits within a small and growing, high-caliber unit where team leaders boast Hedge Fund, Private Equity, and Investment Banking experience. Team members are expected to operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, contributing directly to core research, product, and modeling decisions while working closely with engineering and senior leadership in a highly collaborative, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to decision-makers.

What You'll Do

Convert equity research insights and conclusions into scalable AI equity research platform features that help individual investors with stock discovery, research, and selection
Design and evaluate LLM-based workflows to process unstructured data, analyze it and translate it into structured metrics and factors
Develop and evaluate performance of sector-based factor models using a combination of traditional fundamental research, statistical techniques, and quantitative factor design

Systemic, data driven thinker with the ability to translate fundamental research into a repeatable, systematic strategy, with a strong bias toward building scalable solutions rather than one-off outputs
Multi-sector experience and proven ability to independently perform fundamental research across sectors that has driven long-term investment decisions

Job Description

CAMH’s Institute for Mental Health Policy Research (IMHPR) is seeking a full-time contract (12 months) Research Analyst to assist with a study focused on transgender and gender-diverse youth mental health. The Research Analyst will contribute to a range of research activities across multiple studies, including participant recruitment and data collection; obtaining and maintaining informed consent; administering study questionnaires and interviews; qualitative and quantitative data analysis; and supporting knowledge translation activities. Knowledge translation responsibilities may include developing materials to communicate research findings, such as policy briefs, research reports, infographics, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.

The Research Analyst will also support administrative activities related to youth engagement and ensure that research activities are conducted in accordance with approved study protocols and applicable regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the unique health, social, and structural inequities affecting transgender and gender-diverse individuals, and 2SLGBTQ+ populations more broadly, and will contribute to research that is community-informed, culturally responsive, and grounded in principles of equity.

The successful candidate will work independently while contributing as a member of a multidisciplinary research team and will liaise with community health and housing organizations across Ontario. The Research Analyst will report to a Senior Scientist. This position is located at 250 College Street, Toronto, Ontario.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have completed a bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, public health, or a related field, combined with at least one (1)) year of relevant research and/or clinical experience.

Demonstrated experience conducting research and/or working in partnership 2SLGBTQ+ individuals is required, along with a strong understanding of the health inequities, lived experiences, and social and structural factors affecting diverse 2SLGBTQ+ populations. The successful candidate must demonstrate familiarity with current 2SLGBTQ+ terminology and best practices for culturally safe, affirming, and trauma-informed research.

The successful candidate will have experience contributing to multiple stages of the research process and conducting mixed-methods research. Experience working with large datasets, including survey and/or administrative healthcare data (ICES data) is an asset. Experience with qualitative and quantitative data analysis and the ability to interpret and communicate research findings are required. Familiarity with software such as NVivo, Dedoose, and SPSS is an asset.

This position requires strong interpersonal and communication skills, well-developed critical thinking abilities, flexibility, initiative, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. The successful candidate will be self-directed, highly detail-oriented, and proactive, with excellent organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an Senior Project Manager to lead delivery across the AI and Personalization Platform. This role will bring structure, execution discipline, and cross-functional alignment to the platform capabilities that enable intelligent, relevant, and personalized customer experiences.
If you are energized by turning complex AI opportunities into scalable platform capabilities—and by driving initiatives from strategy and discovery through production launch and continuous improvement—this role is for you.
About the job:

You will join a multidisciplinary AI and Personalization Platform organization spanning product management, AI/ML engineering, software engineering, data engineering, data science, architecture, platform operations, quality assurance, privacy, security, and external partners.
As Senior Project Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery for the AI and Personalization Platform roadmap. You will coordinate initiatives across platform foundations, data and feature capabilities, model and decisioning services, personalization services, experimentation, APIs, integrations, observability, and governance.
You will translate platform strategy into actionable delivery plans, establish clear intake and prioritization, manage dependencies across technical teams, and keep leadership informed through concise, decision-ready reporting. You will help the organization deliver AI and personalization capabilities that are scalable, reliable, measurable, responsible, and ready for enterprise adoption.

Key responsibilities:

Own end-to-end delivery of AI and Personalization Platform initiatives, including problem definition, scope, integrated plans, schedules, risks, dependencies, stakeholder communication, launch readiness, and post-launch measurement.
Build and maintain an integrated platform roadmap, sequencing foundational capabilities, product increments, technical enablers, and enterprise dependencies.
Translate platform strategy, business needs, technical assessments, and prioritized opportunities into milestone-based delivery plans with clear owners, timelines, dependencies, and success criteria.
Establish and run a clear intake and prioritization process for AI and personalization platform requests, balancing strategic value, customer impact, data readiness, technical feasibility, capacity, cost, and risk.
Coordinate delivery across product, AI/ML engineering, software engineering, data engineering, data science, architecture, platform operations, QA, privacy, security, legal, and vendor teams.
Drive the AI and personalization delivery lifecycle from discovery and data readiness through solution design, development, evaluation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate platform capabilities such as data pipelines, feature and profile services, model services, decisioning, recommendation and ranking, experimentation, APIs, integrations, observability, and operational tooling.
Partner with product and technical leaders to define acceptance criteria and evaluation plans covering relevance, accuracy, quality, latency, scalability, reliability, safety, fairness, explainability, cost, adoption, and business outcomes as appropriate.
Establish launch-readiness practices for platform releases, including technical validation, performance testing, integration testing, operational readiness, documentation, support ownership, and rollback planning.
Coordinate monitoring and continuous-improvement plans for production AI and personalization capabilities, including model drift, data quality, performance degradation, service health, unexpected behavior, and changing business conditions.
Establish practical governance for AI and personalization delivery, including privacy, security, responsible-AI controls, data lineage, model or solution documentation, human oversight, approval checkpoints, and auditability.
Run Agile delivery cadences within a product and engineering operating model, including planning, backlog refinement, standups, reviews, retrospectives, roadmap reviews, and release checkpoints.
Proactively manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and decisions (RAID); remove blockers and escalate early with recommended options and trade-offs.
Coordinate build-versus-buy evaluations and vendor/SOW workstreams for AI platforms, personalization services, data products, experimentation tools, and supporting technologies.
Track staffing, including FTE and contractor capacity, budget, platform consumption, vendor spend, and resourcing against plan.

Basic qualifications:

PMP certification from the Project Management Institute required.
7+ years of project or program management experience delivering technical, software, data, platform, AI/ML, or digital initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, data, architecture, operations, and business teams on concurrent, interdependent initiatives.
Experience delivering or operating AI/ML, personalization, recommendation, decisioning, experimentation, or advanced analytics platforms; direct model development is not required.
Working knowledge of the AI/ML and platform delivery lifecycle, including data readiness, solution development, evaluation, deployment, observability, monitoring, iteration, and retirement.
Practical understanding of AI and personalization risks and controls, including privacy, security, bias and fairness, explainability, human oversight, data governance, and model or solution performance.
Experience managing platform initiatives with APIs, integrations, services, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, reliability requirements, or operational support models.
Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum delivery as well as hybrid and waterfall approaches, and with delivery tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
Proven track record of dependency, risk, issue, vendor, and stakeholder management on complex, multi-team programs.
Strong executive communication and status-reporting skills, with the ability to make AI concepts, platform dependencies, uncertainty, and trade-offs clear to both technical and business audiences.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Extra credit:

Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt evaluation, content generation, or conversational AI platforms.
Experience delivering recommendation systems, next-best-action, ranking, propensity, customer segmentation, profile, decisioning, or real-time personalization capabilities.
Familiarity with MLOps, model monitoring, feature stores, data quality, experimentation platforms, model registries, evaluation frameworks, or feature and decisioning services.
Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, APIs, event-driven architectures, streaming data, microservices, observability, platform reliability, and infrastructure-as-code.
Experience establishing responsible-AI governance, model-risk processes, privacy reviews, security reviews, or enterprise AI standards.
Experience managing platform modernization, technical-debt reduction, scalability improvements, performance optimization, or reliability programs.
Additional certifications such as PMI-ACP, CSM/PSM, SAFe, or an AI/ML, product, cloud, or data certification.
Experience managing build-versus-buy evaluations and vendor-delivered AI, personalization, data, or platform workstreams.
Retail, convenience-retail, loyalty, consumer technology, or customer-experience platform experience.

What success looks like:

The AI and Personalization Platform roadmap is prioritized, transparent, and connected to measurable customer, platform, and business outcomes.
Platform initiatives move predictably from intake through production launch with clear ownership, evaluation criteria, governance, and decision points.
Core platform capabilities are scalable, reliable, observable, secure, and ready for adoption by downstream product and engineering teams.
Production AI and personalization services are monitored and improved using agreed quality, relevance, adoption, operational, and financial measures.
Stakeholders have a shared view of delivery status, risks, dependencies, capacity, platform costs, and expected value.
Teams use repeatable delivery and governance practices that enable responsible innovation without compromising privacy, security, reliability, or customer trust.

WSP is seeking a Project Manager for our Power Delivery Project Management team located in Rochester, NY; Syracuse, NY; New York City, NY; Boston, MA; Portland, ME; or Newark, NJ.
