This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
May participate, and at times, lead the contract negotiations and client presentations
Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan.
Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
Provide guidance and mentoring to other staff.
Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market.
12 years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry
Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.
Minimum of 5 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects.
Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:
Contract Management
External and Internal Team Meeting Management
Earned Value Management
Change Management
Risk Management
Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
Financial Management

Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
Occasional travel is required and travel frequency will depend on client and project-specific requirements.

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Project Manager

Softrip | Remote (US-based) | Full Time or Part Time

About Softrip

Softrip is the operating system for the world's best multi-day tour operators. For over two decades, we've powered the booking, operations, finance, and fulfillment workflows, serving as the ERP for our customers’ complex businesses. Our customers run multi-destination, multi-currency operations and they trust Softrip to be the backbone of all of it. We're not a plug-and-play SaaS tool. We are deep infrastructure, and we take that seriously.

We're growing — both in the sophistication of our platform and in the expectations our customers have of us — and we need someone who can match that.

The Role

We're looking for a direct, organized, and relentlessly accountable Project Manager
to own the end-to-end timeline management of complex enterprise onboardings and the prioritized workstreams of our existing customers.

This is not a coordinator role. This is not a "keep the trains running" role. This is a role for someone who can hold their own in a multi-stakeholder implementation and keep both sides executing with precision — while simultaneously keeping 4–6 active customer engagements moving forward without dropping a single thread.

You will join the connective tissue between our customers, our Customer Success team, our Product and Engineering teams, and our executive leadership. You'll own timelines, surface risks before they become fires. You tenaciously pursue the information you need to keep parties on track and make a project successful.

What You'll Own

Enterprise Onboardings

Lead end-to-end project management of new customer implementations from signed contract through go-live and stabilization
Collaborate on detailed implementation project plans with our Director of Onboarding

Facilitate working sessions, data migration reviews, UAT cycles, and go-live readiness assessments with onboarding customers

Hold both sides accountable to deadlines and meeting milestones

Proactively identify blockers — on our side and the customer's — and escalate or resolve them before they cascade

Manage the transition from onboarding into steady-state Customer Success with clean documentation and zero information loss

Existing Customer Workstreams

Partner with the CS team and Engineering to triage, sequence, and communicate delivery timelines for customer-requested enhancements, integrations, and configurations
Run cross-functional coordination for customer-driven projects — Net->Next platform transitions, new integrations, etc. — from scoping through delivery

Own the customer-facing project communications: status updates, risk flags, revised timelines — delivered proactively, never reactively

Process & Infrastructure

Build and improve the operational playbooks, templates, and tooling that make our delivery repeatable and scalable
Track and report on project health metrics: time-to-go-live, on-time delivery rate

Contribute institutional knowledge to the team; document what's working and fix what isn't

What We're Looking For

Required

5+ years of project management experience in complex, multi-stakeholder environments — software, technology, or professional services preferred
Demonstrated track record of owning projects end-to-end — from kickoff through delivery — with full accountability for timelines, stakeholder alignment, and outcomes

Strong project management fundamentals: you can build a Gantt in your sleep, you know what a critical path is, and you understand how to sequence dependencies across teams that don't always move at the same speed

Excellent written and verbal communication — you can send an email to a customer's COO and their tech lead on the same thread and have both walk away confident

Comfort with ambiguity and complexity; our customers' operations are not simple, and neither are our implementations

Experience managing competing priorities across multiple concurrent accounts without letting anything fall through the cracks

Strong command of project management tooling (Asana, Jira, Monday, or equivalent); ability to make whatever tool we use actually work

Optional But Preferred

Background in travel technology, hospitality software, ERP, or operations-heavy platforms
Experience working in a smaller, high-growth company where you've had to build process from scratch rather than inherit it

PMP certification or equivalent training

Familiarity with data migration projects, API integrations, or software configuration workflows

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Every active onboarding has a living, accurate project plan that the customer and internal team trust
Go-lives happen on time (or ahead of schedule) with clear documentation of what was delivered and what comes next

Existing customer workstreams are visible, prioritized, and communicated — no surprises, no dropped commitments

The CS and Engineering teams know exactly what you own and trust you to run it

Why Softrip

We are a small team doing genuinely hard work for customers who depend on us. We have strong customer relationships, a platform that has real depth, and a leadership team that takes quality seriously. This role has direct visibility to the CEO and CS leadership, real ownership over how we deliver, and the opportunity to build the function — not just fill it.

If you want to be the person who makes a complicated, high-stakes operation run smoothly and has the scars and the satisfaction to show for it, we want to hear from you.

Softrip is an equal opportunity employer.

French & Parrello Associates (FPA) is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our growing Geotechnical Department at our headquarters in Wall Township, NJ. This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished geotechnical engineering professional to lead complex projects, strengthen client relationships, mentor technical teams, and build a long-term career with one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing engineering consulting firms.

Recognized year after year as one of NJBIZ’s Best Places to Work in New Jersey, FPA is committed to creating a culture where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and succeed. In 2026, FPA was ranked #49 on Zweig’s Hot Firm List, recognizing the firm among the 100 fastest-growing AEC firms in the United States and Canada. Our continued growth is driven by our investment in our people, technical excellence, and commitment to delivering innovative solutions for the communities we serve.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience managing geotechnical projects and providing technical leadership in geotechnical investigation, analysis, and design. Working closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, this individual will oversee all aspects of project delivery.

This role offers the opportunity to develop practical solutions to complex geotechnical challenges and help guide the continued growth of FPA’s geotechnical practice. The Project Manager will cultivate client relationships, mentor junior engineers and technical staff, and contribute to proposals and new business opportunities.

Geotechnical Engineering Expertise & Project Experience

FPA’s Geotechnical Department provides investigation, analysis, design, and construction-phase services for diverse infrastructure and development projects. Our professionals evaluate subsurface conditions and develop practical recommendations that support safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible project delivery.

The Project Manager – Geotechnical will oversee projects from initial investigation and feasibility evaluation through design and construction support. This role requires strong technical expertise, project management experience, and the ability to coordinate with clients, regulatory agencies, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams while managing multiple assignments.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage geotechnical engineering projects from inception through completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and meet client expectations.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and regulatory agencies, providing technical advice and strategic direction as needed.

Supervise and mentor junior engineers, geologists, and technicians, ensuring their professional development and adherence to company standards.
Prepare and review geotechnical investigation reports, feasibility studies, and technical specifications for clients and contractors.
Ensure high standards of quality control, review project deliverables, and provide constructive feedback to team members.
Develop project budgets, track project costs, and monitor schedules, proactively addressing any issues that could impact project delivery.
Assist in identifying new business opportunities, preparing proposals, and supporting marketing initiatives to grow the geotechnical division.
Ensure all projects comply with local, state, and federal regulations and maintain the highest standards of safety and environmental responsibility.

Qualifications

Master's degree in Geotechnical Engineering or related discipline preferred.

Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in geotechnical engineering, with a focus on project management and leadership.
Experience with geotechnical site investigations, foundation design, soil-structure interaction, and remedial solutions.
Prior experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and interacting with clients.
Strong technical expertise in geotechnical engineering, including software tools for analysis

Large firms offer scale. FPA offers opportunity.

For more than 50 years, French & Parrello Associates (FPA) has been delivering innovative engineering solutions that shape communities, improve infrastructure, and support regional growth. Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:
06/10/2026

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Aviation (Airside Development)
new_jobs.description:
TYLin
is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Aviation (Airside Development) to lead the planning, design, and delivery of complex airside infrastructure projects at major airports. This is an outstanding opportunity to join one of the industry's leading aviation practices and contribute to transformational airport capital programs that enhance safety, capacity, and operational efficiency.

We are looking for a project manager with a proven track record of delivering airside development projects at large commercial airports in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will have experience managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating with airport owners, airlines, regulatory agencies, and construction partners to deliver projects in active operational environments.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Opportunity

As Project Manager – Aviation (Airside Development), you will oversee the delivery of complex aviation infrastructure projects from planning and design through construction support. You will manage technical teams, coordinate with airport stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with airport operational requirements.

This role requires a strong understanding of airfield operations, FAA design standards, phasing and constructability, and the unique challenges associated with delivering projects while maintaining uninterrupted airport operations.

Responsibilities

Lead the planning, design, and delivery of major airside infrastructure projects.
Manage multidisciplinary project teams consisting of civil engineers, airfield planners, pavement specialists, electrical engineers, architects, environmental professionals, and specialty consultants.
Serve as the primary point of contact with airport owners, program management teams, regulatory agencies, and project stakeholders.
Develop project execution plans, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate design development, permitting, procurement, construction support, and project closeout activities.
Manage consultant performance, quality assurance, project controls, and client communications.
Coordinate closely with airport operations to minimize impacts on aircraft movements and airport functionality during construction.
Support contractor coordination, phasing reviews, staging plans, and operational readiness activities.
Identify project risks and develop practical solutions to maintain schedule, budget, and operational objectives.
Prepare executive-level presentations, technical reports, and project status updates.
Mentor junior project managers and technical staff while contributing to the continued growth of TYLin's Aviation practice.

Qualifications Required

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Airport Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Planning or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience managing aviation infrastructure projects, including significant experience on airside developments.
Demonstrated experience delivering projects at major commercial airports in the United States or internationally.
Strong knowledge of FAA airport design standards, Advisory Circulars, airfield geometry, and operational requirements.
Experience managing multidisciplinary design and engineering teams.
Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience coordinating projects within active airport operational environments.

Preferred

Experience delivering projects for the Port Authority of New York & New Jersey (PANYNJ).
Experience with FAA Airport Improvement Program (AIP)-funded projects.
Familiarity with ICAO standards and international airport development projects.
Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR), or Public-Private Partnership (P3) delivery methods.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Typical Project Experience

The successful candidate will have experience managing projects such as:

Runway and taxiway rehabilitation, reconstruction, and expansion
Airfield geometry improvements
Apron and aircraft parking facilities
Aircraft taxi lane and taxilane systems
Deicing facilities
Airfield lighting and navigational aid infrastructure
Airfield drainage and utility improvements
Aircraft support infrastructure
Cargo apron developments
Airside civil infrastructure supporting terminal redevelopment programs

Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced aviation project manager who understands the operational complexity of delivering projects in active airfield environments. You can balance technical excellence, regulatory compliance, stakeholder expectations, and construction sequencing while maintaining the highest standards of safety and operational continuity.

You are comfortable working directly with airport authorities, airlines, FAA representatives, contractors, and multidisciplinary consultant teams, and you excel at building trusted client relationships while successfully leading complex capital projects.

Why TYLin?

TYLin partners with airport owners around the world to deliver innovative aviation infrastructure that improves safety, efficiency, resilience, and the passenger experience. As part of our Aviation practice, you'll collaborate with industry-leading professionals on some of the most complex and high-profile airport programs in North America.

We offer:

Opportunities to lead landmark airside infrastructure projects.
Collaboration with nationally recognized aviation engineers, planners, and program managers.
A dynamic, multidisciplinary work environment focused on technical excellence and innovation.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
Professional development and career advancement within a global infrastructure consulting firm.

Join Us

If you're an experienced aviation project manager with a passion for delivering complex airside infrastructure projects at major airports, we invite you to join TYLin.

Bring your expertise to a team that's shaping the future of aviation infrastructure—one runway, taxiway, and airfield at a time.

Additional Information

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $153,600- $230,400 annually for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. TYLin is proud to offer exciting career development opportunities.

TYLin
offers a comprehensive total rewards package. Our benefits may include extensive medical, disability and life insurance coverage, continuing education benefits, paid time off, employee assistance program and a retirement savings plan with company matching contributions.

We encourage all candidates to explore our total rewards offering.

Collaboration, mission-driven focus, discipline, and leadership skills developed through military service benefit us all. Whether you are a Veteran, Guardsman or Reservist, a Military Spouse or you are planning to transition to civilian life in the near future, we welcome and value your application.

TYLin
is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type as protected by federal, provincial, state or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The company and its employees are required to comply with all local health authority, legal or lawful client requirements.

Project Manager – Municipal Services

Hackettstown, NJ, US

French & Parrello Associates (FPA) is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our growing Municipal Services Department at our headquarters in Hackettstown, NJ. This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished civil engineering professional to lead municipal infrastructure projects from planning through construction, serve as a trusted partner to municipal clients, and build a long-term career with one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing engineering consulting firms.

Recognized year after year as one of NJBIZ’s Best Places to Work in New Jersey, FPA is committed to creating a culture where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and succeed. In 2026, FPA was ranked #49 on Zweig’s Hot Firm List, recognizing the firm among the 100 fastest-growing AEC firms in the United States and Canada. Our continued growth is driven by our investment in our people, technical excellence, and commitment to delivering innovative solutions for the communities we serve.

The successful candidate will have experience managing municipal or public infrastructure projects from concept through construction. This individual will be an effective communicator and collaborative leader with the ability to manage multiple projects, guide multidisciplinary teams, maintain schedules and budgets, and mentor engineering staff.

Municipal Engineering Expertise & Project Experience

FPA’s Municipal Services Department supports municipal clients throughout New Jersey with the planning, design, permitting, and construction administration of municipal infrastructure and capital improvement projects. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with municipalities, regulatory agencies, and utility providers to deliver practical solutions that address community infrastructure needs.

The Project Manager – Municipal Services will oversee projects from initial planning through design and construction, with responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, technical quality, and overall delivery. Serving as the primary point of contact for municipal clients, this individual will coordinate project teams and stakeholders, lead client and public meetings, oversee construction administration activities, and help resolve technical issues throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Lead the planning, design, and execution of municipal infrastructure projects, including roadway improvements, drainage systems, water distribution, sanitary sewer systems, and capital improvement programs.
Serve as Project Manager responsible for scope, schedule, budget, and overall project delivery.
Prepare, review, and oversee engineering calculations, technical specifications, reports, and construction documents in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.
Oversee the development of plans, profiles, and construction details using design software such as AutoCAD Civil 3D.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including engineers, designers, and subconsultants, to ensure successful project execution.
Act as primary point of contact for municipal clients, regulatory agencies, and utility providers.
Lead client meetings, public presentations, and coordination meetings with stakeholders.
Oversee review of shop drawings, RFIs, and contractor submittals during construction administration.
Provide senior-level construction support, including field visits and resolution of technical issues.
Develop and manage project budgets, schedules, and cost estimates.
Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and agency requirements.
Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineering staff, fostering professional development and technical growth.
Support business development efforts and contribute to proposal preparation as needed.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
Minimum of 10+ years of experience in municipal engineering or public infrastructure design and delivery.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of New Jersey required.
Proven experience managing municipal infrastructure projects from concept through construction.
Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong knowledge of municipal design standards, permitting processes, and regulatory requirements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to clients and public agencies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and budgets simultaneously.
Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring engineering staff.
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as needed.

Additional Information

Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available for this position.
Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Don't meet every qualification? At FPA, we recognize that great candidates bring diverse experiences and perspectives. If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience may be exactly what we need for this role or another opportunity within our growing team.

The FPA Difference

Large firms offer scale. FPA offers opportunity.

For more than 50 years, French & Parrello Associates (FPA) has been delivering innovative engineering solutions that shape communities, improve infrastructure, and support regional growth. As an employee-owned, mid-sized engineering and consulting firm, FPA combines the technical capabilities and expertise of a larger organization with the collaboration, accessibility, and personal investment of a close-knit team.

At FPA, engineers are empowered to take ownership of their work, collaborate across disciplines, and experience the full project lifecycle. Your career is not defined by one task or limited to one area of expertise. Instead, you will have the opportunity to strengthen your technical skills, work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful infrastructure projects, and develop the experience needed to grow into future engineering leadership roles.

Our multidisciplinary approach allows team members to see the bigger picture, collaborate with experts across multiple disciplines, and understand how their work impacts the communities we serve. We invest in our people through mentorship, professional development, and opportunities for advancement because we believe the success of our employees drives the continued success of our firm.

At FPA, you are not just designing infrastructure, you are helping build a growing organization while contributing to projects that make a lasting impact.

Benefits

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 1st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement plans. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

Compensation

The projected compensation range for this position is $115,000 to $155,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, education, qualifications, and skill set. FPA recognizes and rewards performance through an annual bonus program.

Project Manager – Telecommunications

Wall Township, NJ, US

French & Parrello Associates (FPA) is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our growing Telecommunications Department at our headquarters in Wall Township, NJ. This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished professional to lead telecommunications infrastructure projects, strengthen client relationships, guide multidisciplinary teams, and build a long-term career with one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing engineering consulting firms.

Recognized year after year as one of NJBIZ’s Best Places to Work in New Jersey, FPA is committed to creating a culture where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and succeed. In 2026, FPA was ranked #49 on Zweig’s Hot Firm List, recognizing the firm among the 100 fastest-growing AEC firms in the United States and Canada. Our continued growth is driven by our investment in our people, technical excellence, and commitment to delivering innovative solutions for the communities we serve.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience managing telecommunications, utility, or related infrastructure projects in a consulting environment. Working closely with clients and project stakeholders, this individual will oversee all aspects of project delivery while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, technical standards, and quality requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to lead projects from initial planning and design through permitting and construction support. The Project Manager will serve as the primary client contact, mentor junior staff, resolve project challenges, and contribute to proposals and business development initiatives.

Telecommunications Engineering & Project Experience

FPA’s Telecommunications Department provides planning, design, permitting, and construction support services for telecommunications infrastructure projects, including small cell deployments, fiber-optic infrastructure, wireless facilities, and related utility improvements.

The Project Manager – Telecommunications will lead multiple projects, coordinate work across disciplines, and oversee the preparation of engineering plans, specifications, permit applications, and construction documents. This role requires the technical knowledge, leadership, and organizational skills needed to manage schedules, budgets, staffing, and competing priorities while delivering high-quality work that meets client expectations.

Responsibilities

Manage telecommunications projects including small cell deployments, fiber optic infrastructure, wireless facilities, utility coordination, and related civil/site development improvements.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, subcontractors, utility companies, municipalities, and internal project teams.
Coordinate project schedules, budgets, staffing, and deliverables to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Oversee the preparation and review of engineering plans, specifications, permit applications, and construction documents.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including civil, structural, electrical, survey, environmental, and permitting staff.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify and resolve issues impacting scope, schedule, or budget.
Attend client meetings, site visits, and project coordination meetings as needed.
Assist with proposal preparation, scope development, fee estimates, and business development initiatives.
Support construction administration activities including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and coordinating with contractors during construction.
Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations, client standards, and company quality standards.
Mentor junior staff and support professional growth within the department.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, or a related field.
10+ years of experience managing telecommunications, utility, or infrastructure-related projects within a consulting engineering or multidisciplinary engineering environment.
Knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure including fiber optic systems, wireless facilities, utility coordination, and permitting processes.
Strong understanding of project management principles including budgeting, scheduling, resource coordination, and client management.
Experience coordinating with municipalities, utility companies, regulatory agencies, and telecommunications carriers.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.
Experience with AutoCAD/Civil 3D, Revit, O-Calc, tnxTower, RISA, and other structural analysis software is preferred.
Familiarity with applicable telecommunications and structural design standards and codes including TIA-222, AISC, and ACI.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of New Jersey required.
PMP certification; Preferred but not required.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to project sites and client meetings as needed.

Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available for this position.
Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience may be exactly what we need for this role or another opportunity within our growing team.

Large firms offer scale. FPA offers opportunity.

For more than 50 years, French & Parrello Associates (FPA) has been delivering innovative engineering solutions that shape communities, improve infrastructure, and support regional growth. As an employee-owned, mid-sized engineering and consulting firm, FPA combines the technical capabilities and expertise of a larger organization with the collaboration, accessibility, and personal investment of a close-knit team.

new_jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About The Role

Payments at Gusto aren't just infrastructure — they're the reason people get paid on time, every time. Payment Operations sits within Gusto's Money team, a cross-functional group spanning Engineering, Product, and Operations that powers money movement across Gusto's growing product surface: core payroll, contractor payments, international money movement, and new business offerings like PEO.

As a Payment Operations Analyst, you'll own specific end-to-end payment workflows, resolve exceptions that require real judgment, and help make our systems more reliable and efficient over time. Gusto's payment surface area is expanding — and this team is at the center of that growth.

This is a role for someone who can shift from investigating a single misfired transaction to coordinating a response on a payment outage affecting thousands — and bring the same rigor to both. You think in systems. You hold partners accountable. You lead with curiosity and embrace AI as a core part of how you work.

You'll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Accounting, Risk, and CX — and you'll develop strong day-to-day relationships with Gusto's bank and payment partners. When something breaks or slows down, you're the one who drives it to resolution.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Support the payment lifecycle end-to-end

Own the operational layer of specific payment workflows — ACH processing, exception handling, refunds, collection re-debits, reconciliation. When something is off, you investigate, escalate where needed, and see it through to resolution. And when you see a pattern, you push to fix the root cause.

Build alongside Product and Engineering

Payment Operations doesn't just react — we shape how the systems work. You'll contribute to product specs, surface operational pain points, help define requirements, and participate in launches. You're a partner in building, not just a consumer of what gets shipped.

Close the loop on customer pain

Customer and CX feedback is signal. You actively mine it to identify friction in payment flows, prioritize what matters, and bring those insights into the operational and product conversations where decisions get made.

Think in systems

Connect the dots across rails, partners, reconciliation, compliance, and customer experience. When an issue surfaces, you understand how it ripples — and you bring that perspective to cross-functional conversations.

Hold partners to a high standard

Work directly with Gusto's bank and payment partners — domestic and international — to triage issues, resolve escalations, and maintain strong working relationships. You know how to be firm and collaborative at the same time, and you don't let things sit. Lead with AI You use AI as a genuine work partner — to move faster on analysis, draft communications, synthesize data, and automate the repetitive. You're always looking for the smarter way to get to the answer.

Here’s What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience in payment operations, banking operations, treasury operations, or a related role at a fintech or financial institution
Working knowledge of domestic payment rails (ACH/Nacha, wires, RTP) and/or international money movement (cross-border transfers, FX, global disbursement networks); experience across both is a strong plus
Strong analytical instincts — you look for the pattern behind the problem and can query or structure data to find it (SQL a plus but not required)
Experience working with bank portals, payment processors, or reconciliation tools
Ability to communicate clearly with both operational and technical counterparts; you can write a crisp Slack to an engineer and a professional escalation to a bank partner
Comfortable working in ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for perfect information
Eager to build AI into how you work — whether you're already using it daily or just getting started, you see it as a genuine productivity lever and are committed to developing that fluency
Knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks (Nacha operating rules, unclaimed property, money transmission) is a strong plus

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days
per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon, Managed by Collins Aerospace

The IFF Directorate, Identification Friend or Foe, within the Collins Aerospace Mission Systems team, is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to lead our Production Programs and Platform Integration efforts across multiple domestic and international platforms. Immediate responsibilities include managing multiple production contracts and supporting existing product deliveries, including customer communications and DMS management. Duties include management of all cost, schedule, and technical execution of assigned programs. The individual will work closely with multiple customers and will require solid interpersonal /relationship skills to secure new business in support of the IFF Annual Operating Plan (AOP) commitments.

The Sr. Program Manager will communicate with senior management (and/or customers) through briefing packages, EACs, and technical proposals, Gate Reviews and present Program Plans that accurately reflect the program's health and must be achievable. Since there are generally no direct reports to the PM in a matrixed organization, the PM must have good communication skills to engage the team and functional management to achieve results. This will include working with section and department managers to ensure the team members have the correct technical skills to execute the program. The PM must continue to evaluate the needed skills and develop high performing teams. Given the size and complexity of these efforts, delegation and supervision of work products is necessary to ensure technical results as well as cost and schedule.

This is an Onsite position at our Aberdeen, MD location. Relocation is not provided.

What You Will Do:

Accountable for the full lifecycle of products and services from inception through completion, inclusive of pursuit and order capture, design and development, produce to deliver, service/support, and long-term strategic business plans. Support new product launch and production start up for Next Generation products.
Assigned as the chair of the Program Management Team (PMT) accountable for managing the contract lifecycle, cost schedule, performance and on-time delivery of company programs
Serves as the face of the organization to clients and customers
Has Profit & Loss (P&L) responsibility for a specified value stream or group of value streams within a business segment or portfolio

Qualifications You Must Have:

Minimum of 8 years’ experience leading multi-disciplined teams, experience creating/pursuing leads and winning military and/or commercial contract awards
Typically requires: Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of prior relevant experience OR Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.
PM experience for programs valued up to $25M
Experience working in the defense and/or aerospace market with U.S. Department of Defense or other Government agencies and OEMs
Demonstrated experience in leading development programs and Capture/proposals
Demonstrated ability to initiate and sustain positive customer relationships
Demonstrated understanding and proficient use of program management tools such as Earned Value Management System (EVMS), Integrated Master Plan (IMP) / Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), Risk and Opportunity Management or similar business processes
Proficient in managing multiple contract types (CPFF, FFP, DCS, FMS)
Effective communication/presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills
Willingness to engage foreign customers and travel both domestically and internationally as required, (~25%)

Qualifications We Prefer:

Knowledge of IFF, Airborne Radio or Radar Systems, Production systems
Avionics development, certification, and prime mission system integration support
Strong experience and relationships within US DoD and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) aviation community
Experience leading larger production scope contracts including post delivery customer support
Experience with International Direct Commercial Sales and Foreign Military Sales (FMS)
Direct involvement working through ITAR, Export/Import and licensing regulations
Subcontractor management for technical development efforts.
EV Certified / PM Certification
Preference for a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Management or similar field

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defense industry. Collins Aerospace has the capabilities, comprehensive portfolio and expertise to solve customers’ toughest challenges and to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving global market.

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customer succeeds today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE.

Description

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos
, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos Digital Solutions, Inc. (LDSI) has an opportunity for an Assistant
Project Manager
to assist in leading various technical projects and program operational effort. The project opportunities include workflow mapping and documentation, configuration management, security and employee compliance tracking, and more. Communications and coordination include multiple teams within our program including software testing, technical training, customer support and systems engineering.

This is a hybrid role for someone who can come into the Alexandria or Washington DC office at least once per quarter and periodically as needed for meetings.

Primary Responsibilities

Capture project requirements, track, and report on status. Ensure that project work is executed efficiently and on schedule.
Manage and evaluate change requests, configuration, and master data in our proprietary CRM system. Efforts include tracking Congressional customer contacts, communications, and designing workflows based on process analysis.
Prepare and organize documentation on processes, SOP guides and instructional documents for the program.
Manage the creation, storage, and delivery of contractually required technical documentation and customer deliverable reports.
Assist in various ongoing tasks and tracking for employee onboarding, customer clearances, compliance and training.
Identify and manage projects for process improvements in various areas of the program.

What Sets You Apart: (Basic Qualifications)

Requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent and two years or less business experience.
Leadership skills in project management with ability to lead others and garner cooperation from individuals across teams.
Strong organizational skills and ability to evaluate processes and improve workflow.
Proficient in M365 Office applications with ability to quickly learn new technologies and software.
Demonstrable experience with advanced functions and formulas in Excel and data analysis (such as the application of formulas like VLOOKUP, Data and Pivot Tables, visual charts to show trending, data manipulation, and analysis, etc.)
Ability to oversee, administer and manage data in the IQ CRM software, evaluating the impact of change requests and developing solutions for business process enablement.
Understanding and using analytical skills to develop solutions to challenging issues.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written with insight into the audience.
Ability to work independently and to reliably keep recurring tasks and deliverables on schedule.

You Might Also Have: (Preferred Qualifications)

CAPM®, PMP® or other PMI Certification.
Experience managing people.
Training experience, online or in person.
Knowledge of business financial tracking.

Are you ready to make an impact? Begin your journey of a flourishing and meaningful career; share your resume with us today!

We take care of our employees.
Leidos seeks the best and the brightest, and in return, we invest in you, with an eye on your future, through career advancement, growth opportunities and continuous improvement via mentoring, formal and informal project management training and assistance with obtaining pertinent certifications. We challenge you to help solve some of the world’s toughest problems, and reward you with a welcoming culture that recognizes the importance of a strong work/life balance, as well as competitive compensation and benefits. We believe that diversity and inclusion make us all better and offer the chance to have fun and make a difference

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

September 18, 2026

new_jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
MTSI Defense Services Division is seeking an experienced Information System Security Manager (ISSM)
to lead cybersecurity efforts for a Navy-centric environment focused on ensuring the security and compliance of information systems. As the ISSM, you will play a key leadership role in managing and overseeing the security posture of information systems, ensuring their compliance with DoD standards and the Risk Management Framework (RMF).

You will work across multidisciplinary teams to maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the program's critical systems and data. You will be supporting onsite operations independently with the potential to grow a small team for scaling cybersecurity capabilities.

You’ll be a great fit for this role if:

You have 5+ years of combined experience working in defensive/offensive cybersecurity, information assurance, penetration testing, or related fields.
You have knowledge of the Department of Navy and Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), including digital infrastructure/environments, DevSecOps, Continuous Integration/Continuous Development (CI/CD), and continuous Authority to Operate (cATO).
You have proven experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining multi-level security architectures across cloud, infrastructure, and platform applications.
You have strong technical expertise in identifying and developing cyberspace operations requirements, processes, and security controls.
You have experience designing and operating enterprise security controls and conducting incident response.
You have analytical skills to assess capability development requirements, system architectures, and emerging cybersecurity technologies.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate complex issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You have the ability to work independently and in a fast-paced team environment with changing priorities.
You have the ability and motivation to learn new skills in an evolving information security landscape.
You are willing to travel up to 20% as required.

Qualifications Required

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Certificates in cybersecurity, specific systems, or tools may be accepted in lieu of a degree on a case-by-case basis.
Active Secret clearance required, with the ability to obtain Top Secret/SCI eligibility.
Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.

Certification Requirements

IAM Level 2: CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+), Certified Authorization Professional (CAP).

Even Better If You Have These Desired Skills

Proficiency in using security tools such as Splunk, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel, FortiSIEM, SwimLane, QRadar, and LogPoint for monitoring, assessing, and reporting system security vulnerabilities.
Hands-on experience with security monitoring, log analysis, threat intelligence, and digital forensics to identify and respond to system anomalies.
Experience with defending against known attack vectors.

The pay range for this position in is $130,000/year to $165,000/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on established government contract ranges, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, and other factors. MTSI also offers a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Base pay information is based on market location. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis. This posting will be renewed periodically until the position is filled.

new_jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Amentum Technology Inc. (ATI)
is the Large Business Team Lead for a newly awarded five-year contract in the Maryland area. The program delivers enterprise-wide cybersecurity and Risk Management Framework (RMF) support across the customer’s enterprise. The Deputy Program Manager (DPM)
provides executive-level leadership and operational oversight in support of a large, complex cybersecurity program. Reporting to the Program Manager, the DPM assists in directing all aspects of contract performance, including program execution, workforce management, financial management, schedule adherence, risk mitigation, customer relations, and quality assurance across multiple Prime Technical Task Orders (TTOs).

The DPM serves as a trusted advisor to the Program Manager and customer stakeholders, ensuring mission success through effective coordination of technical and operational teams, continuous process improvement, and disciplined program management practices. The DPM also serves as the designated alternate to the Program Manager and assumes leadership responsibilities as required.

Work Schedule:

In office, Monday–Friday, 5 days/week, 8 hours/day. Program hours are flexible within 0600–1800, core hours are 1000-1400. On-call availability required to support PMO surge events and incident response.

Essential Responsibilities:

As the senior operational leader, you will:

Lead day-to-day PMO operations across the contract teams; serve as deputy operational authority and trusted delegate to the Program Manager for execution decisions on cost, schedule, resource allocation, and customer engagement.
Develop and drive team workflows and processes.
Own monitoring, tracking, and reporting of performance, schedule, cost, and risk across all TTOs using software tools and analysis.
Manage the CDRL and non-CDRL deliverables portfolio, including Financial Report, Status, Compliance and Inventory.
Coordinate and facilitate the recurring PMO business tempo: Status Meetings, Standups, Monthly Status Reviews, and Quarterly Program Reviews.
Issue immediate verbal and written notification to the CO/COR within one working day of any event that may jeopardize cost, schedule, or technical performance.
Lead Capabilities/Needs List process to anticipate and resolve customer needs, long-term direction shifts, and mission surges
Coordinate requirements with the PMO functional team: TTO Leads, Contracts Manager, Subcontracts Manager, Finance/Accounting Lead, Recruiting, Program related Coordinator, CSSO, and Asset Manager.
Partner with the Finance Lead on EAC, accruals, invoicing, reporting, and limitation of funds notifications; ensure cost performance stays within funded ceilings.
Maintain the Contractor Position Roster Log (CPRL/eCPRL) in coordination with the CSSO.
Govern the Risk Register inside the shared PMO Portal; lead monthly risk review cadence, update mitigation owners, and elevate program-level risks to impacted parties and the customer.
Coordinate Government Furnished Property/Equipment (GFP/E), Materials & Procurement, Travel, Training, and Section 508 Compliance in partnership with TTO Leads PMO asset team, internal and external stakeholders.
Update the SOPs, Plans and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for incoming TTOs, surges, and contract-level changes.
Champion the ATI team and drive cooperation across the PMO team at ATI space, instill consistent processes, tools, and customer-facing deliverables.
Mentor junior PMO staff — including certification tracking, cross-training across MPO contracts, and career development planning.

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:

Position is performed on-site at ATI PMO facilities and customer site. (Columbia, MD, Hanover, and customer locations within 50-mile radius of Fort Meade, MD). Work is also performed inside a Secure Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) and requires extended periods at a workstation, frequent in-person and virtual stakeholder engagement, and sustained focus across concurrent technical and management priorities. Occasional after-hours and surge response is required. Travel: less than 10%, primarily local to customer and partner sites.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Demonstrated mastery of DoD/IC program management on Cost Plus Award Fee (CPAF) or comparable cost-reimbursable contracts.
Proven ability to manage several concurrent Technical Task Orders (TTOs), CDRL deliverables, and non-standard teaming structures such as JV, MFT or LSMFT.
Working knowledge of NIST RMF, authorization workflows, and cybersecurity service operations.
Strong financial and EVM literacy: EAC, BOE, FLHER, accruals, invoicing, award-fee management, and customer reporting (CDRs, QARs).
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, Power BI, ServiceNow, SharePoint, CostPoint and PMO collaboration tooling.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to brief senior internal and external leadership with composure and precision.
Detail-oriented, systems-thinker with a track record of building repeatable processes, dashboards, and management cadences that scale.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, mentor staff, and collaborate in a team environment.
Ability to maintain composure and decision quality during surge events, audits, and high-visibility customer escalations.

Clearance Required:
TS/SCI w/Poly

Minimum Education:

Bachelor's degree in information systems management, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Master's degree strongly preferred.

Minimum Years of Experience:

Ten (10) years of progressive program management experience supporting DoD or Intelligence Community customers, including a minimum of seven (7) years in a senior PMO leadership role on cleared cybersecurity, RMF, or cyber operations contracts. MPO program experience strongly preferred.

Required Certifications:

Must have a PMP, FAC-P/PM Senior Level, or Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Level 3 certification in Program Management.
Information Assurance Manager (IAM) Level II or III certification (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CASP+) strongly preferred to satisfy DoD 8140 / Cyberspace Workforce Improvement Program (CWIP) workforce coding.

Preferred Qualifications:

Direct experience supporting Maryland Procurement Office (MPO)
Experience as Deputy Program Manager or Program Operations Manager on an LSMFT, JV, or multi-Prime construct with documented Small Business participation goals.
Experience operating or leading a collaborative Program Management structure.
Familiarity with CDRLS/ deliverables and MPO-specific reporting tools and deadlines.
Power BI dashboard design and ServiceNow workflow experience.
Demonstrated use of AI / generative AI tools to accelerate PMO operations — automated status reporting, deliverable drafting, risk register synthesis, and dashboard intelligence.
Master's degree in Information Systems Management, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Computer Science, Management, or related field.
Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt or equivalent process-improvement credential.

Other Responsibilities:

Safety
- Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.

Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.

Procedure Compliance

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Sr. Technical Strategy Analyst serves a critical role within the Command Action Group (CAG), providing direct, high-level support to the Program Director and Deputy Director of a major DoD acquisition program. This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise and executive-level strategic thinking. This role contributes to strategic research, assessments, data analysis, roadmap development, and the preparation of materials that support executive decision ‑ making for large-scale enterprise IT initiatives. Serving as the primary backup to the Technical Strategy Lead, the ideal candidate has strong analytical capabilities, can synthesize complex IT infrastructure information into clear insights, and is comfortable working in a fast ‑ paced CAG environment.

This role is on-site at the Navy Yard in Washington, D.C.

An active Secret clearance is required.

Roles And Responsibilities

Strategy Analysis & Research

Conduct research and analysis on technology trends, capability gaps, and mission requirements related to enterprise IT environments and systems.
Evaluate emerging IT capabilities (e.g., cloud architectures, Zero Trust, DevSecOps, automation) for relevance to the acquisition program.
Develop summaries, insights, and recommendations that inform the Program Director's strategic direction.

Roadmap & Planning Support

Assist in developing multi ‑ year enterprise IT roadmaps, including sequencing, dependencies, and key acquisition milestones.
Maintain and update strategy artifacts, including concept papers, decision briefs, IT vision documents, and alignment frameworks.
Support the integration of technical strategy with engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and program management workstreams.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Partner with the Technical Strategy Lead to support workshops, working sessions, and leadership forums focused on enterprise IT strategy development and alignment.
Gather inputs from stakeholders across technical, operational, and business areas of the Program.
Consolidate feedback and help refine strategy recommendations based on stakeholder insights and acquisition program needs.
Serve as the designated alternate for the Technical Strategy Lead, representing the CAG and the Program Director's interests in senior-level technical and strategic forums during their absence.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

Analyze qualitative and quantitative data related to IT service delivery, system performance, and enterprise technology adoption.
Develop charts, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate modernization trends, risks, and strategic opportunities.
Translate complex engineering and acquisition data into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership decision ‑ making.

Documentation & Executive Communication

Draft, synthesize, and refine strategy documents, white papers, decision briefs, and presentations for leadership evaluation.
Ensure technical IT materials are clear, concise, and tailored to senior audiences across classified and unclassified environments.

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

Active Secret Clearance
7+ years of experience in strategy analysis, digital transformation, enterprise technology, or related analytical roles (Navy preferred).
Strong analytical, research, and problem ‑ solving skills.
Ability to synthesize complex technical and mission ‑ related information into concise insights.
Experience preparing executive-level briefs, reports, and visualizations.
Comfortable working collaboratively with technical, operational, and leadership stakeholders.
Ability to work in classified environments and handle sensitive information appropriately.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a highly related technical discipline. Relevant experience (4+ years in addition to required) may be substituted for degree.
3+ years of demonstrated experience within DoD IT acquisition programs.
Advanced DAWIA certifications in Program Management or Engineering.
Familiarity with modern DoD IT initiatives, including DoD Zero Trust Architecture, Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability (JWCC), and the Software Acquisition Pathway.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $175,000 to $200,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.
